PS C:\Users\nk947\Downloads\robot-runtime-research\esp-tflite-micro> $Path = ".\examples\person_detection\w1_three_runtime_100run_outputs_2026-10-24.csv"

if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $Path)) {
    throw "Three-runtime output CSV was not found."
}

$Rows = @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath $Path)

if ($Rows.Count -eq 0) {
    throw "The three-runtime output CSV contains no records."
}

Write-Host "`n===== RUNTIME COVERAGE ====="

$Rows |
    Group-Object Runtime |
    ForEach-Object {
        [pscustomobject]@{
            Runtime     = $_.Name
            Records     = $_.Count
            ImageCount  = @($_.Group.Image | Sort-Object -Unique).Count
        }
    } |
    Format-Table -AutoSize

Write-Host "`n===== PER-IMAGE OUTPUT COMPARISON ====="

$ExpectedRuntimes = @(
    "R1 Reference",
    "R2A ESP-NN ANSI",
    "R2 ESP-NN Optimized"
)

$Results = foreach ($ImageGroup in ($Rows | Group-Object Image | Sort-Object { [int]$_.Name })) {
    $OutputMap = @{}

    foreach ($Runtime in $ExpectedRuntimes) {
        $MatchingRows = @(
            $ImageGroup.Group | Where-Object { $_.Runtime -eq $Runtime }
        )

        if ($MatchingRows.Count -eq 0) {
            $OutputMap[$Runtime] = "MISSING"
        } else {
            $OutputMap[$Runtime] = @(
                $MatchingRows |
                    ForEach-Object {
                        "$($_.PersonRawINT8):$($_.NoPersonRawINT8)"
                    } |
                    Sort-Object -Unique
            ) -join ";"
        }
    }

    $PresentCount = @(
        $ExpectedRuntimes |
            Where-Object { $OutputMap[$_] -ne "MISSING" }
    ).Count

    $UniqueOutputSets = @(
        $ExpectedRuntimes |
            ForEach-Object { $OutputMap[$_] } |
            Where-Object { $_ -ne "MISSING" } |
            Sort-Object -Unique
    )

    [pscustomobject]@{
        Image              = $ImageGroup.Name
        RuntimeCoverage    = "$PresentCount/3"
        R1Reference        = $OutputMap["R1 Reference"]
        R2A_ANSI            = $OutputMap["R2A ESP-NN ANSI"]
        R2_Optimized        = $OutputMap["R2 ESP-NN Optimized"]
        ExactOutputMatch   = ($PresentCount -eq 3 -and $UniqueOutputSets.Count -eq 1)
    }
}

$Results | Format-Table -AutoSize -Wrap

Write-Host "`n===== OVERALL COMPARISON STATUS ====="
Write-Host "IMAGES_IN_OUTPUT_CSV=$($Results.Count)"
Write-Host "IMAGES_MATCHING_ALL_RUNTIMES=$(@($Results | Where-Object ExactOutputMatch).Count)"
Write-Host "IMAGES_MISSING_AT_LEAST_ONE_RUNTIME=$(@($Results | Where-Object { $_.RuntimeCoverage -ne '3/3' }).Count)"

#if CLI_ONLY_INFERENCE
static int inference_cli_handler(int argc, char *argv[])
{
    /* Just to go to the next line */
    printf("\n");
    if (argc != 2) {
        printf("%s: Incorrect arguments\n", TAG);
        return 0;
    }
    int image_number = atoi(argv[1]);

    if((image_number < 0) || (image_number >= IMAGE_COUNT)) {
        ESP_LOGE(TAG, "Please Enter a valid Number ( 0 - %d)", IMAGE_COUNT-1);
        return -1;
    }
   // char file_name[30];
   // sprintf(file_name, "image%d.raw", image_number);
    unsigned detect_time;
    detect_time = esp_timer_get_time();
    run_inference((void *)image_database[image_number]);
    detect_time = (esp_timer_get_time() - detect_time)/1000;
    ESP_LOGI(TAG,"Time required for the inference is %u ms", detect_time);

    return 0;
}


typedef struct {
    long long us;
    uint32_t cycles;
    int image;
    int raw_person;
    int raw_no_person;
    int ok;
} benchmark_sample_t;

static int compare_long_long(const void *a, const void *b)
{
    long long x = *(const long long *)a;
    long long y = *(const long long *)b;
    return (x > y) - (x < y);
}

static int benchmark_cli_handler(int argc, char *argv[])
{
    if (argc != 2) {
        printf("Usage: benchmark <measured_runs 1..10000>\n");
        return 1;
    }
    char *end = NULL;
    long requested = strtol(argv[1], &end, 10);
    if (end == argv[1] || *end != '\0' || requested < 1 || requested > 10000) {
        printf("ERROR: measured_runs must be between 1 and 10000\n");
        return 1;
    }
    const int runs = (int)requested;
    const int warmup_runs = 10;
    benchmark_sample_t *samples = (benchmark_sample_t *)calloc((size_t)runs, sizeof(*samples));
    long long *sorted = (long long *)calloc((size_t)runs, sizeof(*sorted));
    if (samples == NULL || sorted == NULL) {
        free(samples); free(sorted);
        printf("ERROR: benchmark sample allocation failed\n");
        return 1;
    }
    printf("BENCH_START,runs=%d,warmup=%d,images=%d,timing=interpreter_Invoke_only\n",
           runs, warmup_runs, BENCHMARK_IMAGE_COUNT);
    g_benchmark_mode = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < warmup_runs; ++i) {
        run_inference((void *)image_database[i % BENCHMARK_IMAGE_COUNT]);
        vTaskDelay(1);
    }
    int failures = 0;
    int successful_runs = 0;
    long long sum = 0;

static int inference_cli_handler(int argc, char *argv[])
{
    /* Just to go to the next line */
    printf("\n");
    if (argc != 2) {
        printf("%s: Incorrect arguments\n", TAG);
        return 0;
    }
    int image_number = atoi(argv[1]);

    if((image_number < 0) || (image_number >= IMAGE_COUNT)) {
        ESP_LOGE(TAG, "Please Enter a valid Number ( 0 - %d)", IMAGE_COUNT-1);
        return -1;
    }
   // char file_name[30];
   // sprintf(file_name, "image%d.raw", image_number);
    unsigned detect_time;
    detect_time = esp_timer_get_time();
    run_inference((void *)image_database[image_number]);
    detect_time = (esp_timer_get_time() - detect_time)/1000;
    ESP_LOGI(TAG,"Time required for the inference is %u ms", detect_time);

    return 0;
}


typedef struct {
    long long us;
    uint32_t cycles;
    int image;
    int raw_person;
    int raw_no_person;
    int ok;
} benchmark_sample_t;

static int compare_long_long(const void *a, const void *b)
{
    long long x = *(const long long *)a;
    long long y = *(const long long *)b;
    return (x > y) - (x < y);
}

static int benchmark_cli_handler(int argc, char *argv[])
{
    if (argc != 2) {
        printf("Usage: benchmark <measured_runs 1..10000>\n");
        return 1;
    }
    char *end = NULL;
    long requested = strtol(argv[1], &end, 10);
    if (end == argv[1] || *end != '\0' || requested < 1 || requested > 10000) {
        printf("ERROR: measured_runs must be between 1 and 10000\n");
        return 1;
    }
    const int runs = (int)requested;
    const int warmup_runs = 10;
    benchmark_sample_t *samples = (benchmark_sample_t *)calloc((size_t)runs, sizeof(*samples));
    long long *sorted = (long long *)calloc((size_t)runs, sizeof(*sorted));
    if (samples == NULL || sorted == NULL) {
        free(samples); free(sorted);
        printf("ERROR: benchmark sample allocation failed\n");
        return 1;
    }
    printf("BENCH_START,runs=%d,warmup=%d,images=%d,timing=interpreter_Invoke_only\n",
           runs, warmup_runs, BENCHMARK_IMAGE_COUNT);
    g_benchmark_mode = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < warmup_runs; ++i) {
        run_inference((void *)image_database[i % BENCHMARK_IMAGE_COUNT]);
        vTaskDelay(1);
    }
    int failures = 0;
    int successful_runs = 0;
    long long sum = 0;

PS C:\Users\nk947\Downloads\robot-runtime-research\esp-tflite-micro> $Root = ".\examples\person_detection"
$Csv = Join-Path $Root "chapter_evidence\w1_three_runtime_images10_11_comparison_2026-10-24.csv"
$ExpectedHash = "62898CEF79C79A1B8D7EFB652C32764D7BDBBFEDA119FEBAF6A471BA3242D3CF"

if (-not (Test-Path $Csv)) {
    throw "Comparison CSV is missing."
}

$ActualHash = (Get-FileHash $Csv -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
$Rows = @(Import-Csv $Csv)

if ($ActualHash -ne $ExpectedHash) {
    throw "Comparison CSV hash mismatch."
}

if ($Rows.Count -ne 6) {
    throw "Expected 6 result rows; found $($Rows.Count)."
}

$Runtimes = @($Rows | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Runtime -Unique)
if ($Runtimes.Count -ne 3) {
    throw "Expected results from exactly 3 runtimes."
}

foreach ($Runtime in $Runtimes) {
    $RuntimeRows = @($Rows | Where-Object { $_.Runtime -eq $Runtime })
    if ($RuntimeRows.Count -ne 2) {
        throw "Expected 2 image results for runtime: $Runtime"
    }
    if (@($RuntimeRows | Where-Object { $_.InvokeOK -ne "1" }).Count -gt 0) {
        throw "An inference invocation failed for runtime: $Runtime"
    }
}

$Image10 = @($Rows | Where-Object { $_.ImageID -eq "10" })
$Image11 = @($Rows | Where-Object { $_.ImageID -eq "11" })

if (@($Image10 | Where-Object {
    $_.PersonRawINT8 -ne "113" -or $_.NoPersonRawINT8 -ne "-113"
}).Count -gt 0) {
    throw "Image 10 raw outputs do not match."
}

if (@($Image11 | Where-Object {
    $_.PersonRawINT8 -ne "-57" -or $_.NoPersonRawINT8 -ne "57"
}).Count -gt 0) {
    throw "Image 11 raw outputs do not match."
}

Write-Host "`n===== VALIDATION PASSED ====="
Write-Host "ROW_COUNT=$($Rows.Count)"

Write-Host "INVOKE_FAILURES=0"

$Summary = foreach ($Runtime in $Runtimes) {
    $RuntimeRows = @($Rows | Where-Object { $_.Runtime -eq $Runtime })
    $Average = ($RuntimeRows | ForEach-Object { [double]$_.LatencyMS } |
        Measure-Object -Average).Average

    [PSCustomObject]@{
        Runtime = $Runtime
        Images = $RuntimeRows.Count
        MeanLatencyMS = [math]::Round($Average, 2)
        FirmwareSHA256 = ($RuntimeRows | Select-Object -First 1).FirmwareSHA256
    }
}

PS C:\Users\nk947\Downloads\robot-runtime-research\esp-tflite-micro> $EvidenceRoot = ".\examples\person_detection\chapter_evidence"

$CaptureSpecs = @(
    [PSCustomObject]@{
        Runtime = "R1_REFERENCE"
        Folder = "repeatability_R1_REFERENCE_20261025_093830"
        FirmwareHash = "39D2283D8DEDF17926FED525965F03AD5E75F7D7373353E87B4FF9FFC76CEBDB"
    }
    [PSCustomObject]@{
        Runtime = "R2A_ANSI_C"
        Folder = "repeatability_R2A_ANSI_C_20261025_093117"
        FirmwareHash = "4017A79C30E47A4FC15584617ACC5A86A7CF9511CB8D6F2500A22AE4B9B10143"
    }
    [PSCustomObject]@{
        Runtime = "R2_OPTIMIZED"
        Folder = "repeatability_R2_OPTIMIZED_20261025_094655"
        FirmwareHash = "342977F84831C9559291255C3662A9990F23D19A38BA34555B3D8642605B4CDE"
    }
)

$AllRows = @()

foreach ($Spec in $CaptureSpecs) {
    $File = Join-Path (Join-Path $EvidenceRoot $Spec.Folder) "trial_results.csv"

    if (-not (Test-Path $File)) {
        throw "Missing trial-results file: $File"
    }

    $Part = @(Import-Csv $File)

    if ($Part.Count -ne 20) {
        throw "$($Spec.Runtime): expected 20 rows; found $($Part.Count)"
    }

    if (@($Part | Where-Object {
        $_.runtime -ne $Spec.Runtime -or
        $_.firmware_sha256 -ne $Spec.FirmwareHash
    }).Count -gt 0) {
        throw "$($Spec.Runtime): runtime label or firmware hash mismatch"
    }

    foreach ($ImageId in @(10, 11)) {
        $ImageRows = @($Part | Where-Object { [int]$_.image_id -eq $ImageId })

        if ($ImageRows.Count -ne 10) {
            throw "$($Spec.Runtime), image $ImageId: expected 10 rows"
        }

        if (@($ImageRows | Where-Object { $_.invoke_ok -ne "1" }).Count -gt 0) {
            throw "$($Spec.Runtime), image $ImageId: invocation failure"
        }

        if ($ImageId -eq 10) {
            $ExpectedPerson = "113"
            $ExpectedNoPerson = "-113"
        } else {
            $ExpectedPerson = "-57"
            $ExpectedNoPerson = "57"
        }

        if (@($ImageRows | Where-Object {
            $_.person_raw_int8 -ne $ExpectedPerson -or
            $_.no_person_raw_int8 -ne $ExpectedNoPerson
        }).Count -gt 0) {
            throw "$($Spec.Runtime), image $ImageId: raw output mismatch"
        }

        if (@($ImageRows | Select-Object -ExpandProperty latency_ms -Unique).Count -gt 1) {
            Write-Warning "$($Spec.Runtime), image $ImageId: latency varies across trials"
        }
    }

    $AllRows += $Part
}

if ($AllRows.Count -ne 60) {
    throw "Expected 60 combined rows; found $($AllRows.Count)"
}

$CombinedPath = Join-Path $EvidenceRoot "w1_repeatability_images10_11_combined_2026-10-25.csv"
$SummaryPath = Join-Path $EvidenceRoot "w1_repeatability_images10_11_summary_2026-10-25.csv"

$AllRows | Export-Csv $CombinedPath -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8

$SummaryRows = foreach ($Spec in $CaptureSpecs) {
    foreach ($ImageId in @(10, 11)) {
        $Group = @($AllRows | Where-Object {
            $_.runtime -eq $Spec.Runtime -and [int]$_.image_id -eq $ImageId
        })

        $Latency = @($Group | ForEach-Object { [double]$_.latency_ms } | Sort-Object)
        $Invoke = @($Group | ForEach-Object { [double]$_.invoke_us })
        $UniqueOutputs = @($Group | ForEach-Object {
            "$($_.person_raw_int8),$($_.no_person_raw_int8)"
        } | Select-Object -Unique)

        [PSCustomObject]@{
            Runtime = $Spec.Runtime
            ImageID = $ImageId
            Runs = $Group.Count
            Failures = @($Group | Where-Object { $_.invoke_ok -ne "1" }).Count
            OutputsStable = ($UniqueOutputs.Count -eq 1)
            PersonRawINT8 = $Group[0].person_raw_int8
            NoPersonRawINT8 = $Group[0].no_person_raw_int8
            MeanLatencyMS = [math]::Round(($Latency | Measure-Object -Average).Average, 3)
            P95LatencyMSNearestRank = $Latency[[math]::Ceiling(0.95 * $Latency.Count) - 1]
            MeanInvokeUS = [math]::Round(($Invoke | Measure-Object -Average).Average, 3)
            FirmwareSHA256 = $Spec.FirmwareHash
        }
    }
}

$SummaryRows | Export-Csv $SummaryPath -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8

Write-Host "`n===== COMBINED EVIDENCE VALIDATION PASSED ====="
Write-Host "TOTAL_ROWS=$($AllRows.Count)"
Write-Host "RUNTIME_COUNT=$(@($AllRows | Select-Object -ExpandProperty runtime -Unique).Count)"
Write-Host "FAILED_INVOCATIONS=$(@($AllRows | Where-Object { $_.invoke_ok -ne '1' }).Count)"
Write-Host "COMBINED_CSV=$CombinedPath"
Write-Host "COMBINED_CSV_SHA256=$((Get-FileHash $CombinedPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash)"
Write-Host "SUMMARY_CSV=$SummaryPath"
Write-Host "SUMMARY_CSV_SHA256=$((Get-FileHash $SummaryPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash)"

$SummaryRows | Format-Table Runtime, ImageID, Runs, Failures, OutputsStable, MeanLatencyMS, P95LatencyMSNearestRank, MeanInvokeUS -AutoSize

PS C:\Users\nk947\Downloads\robot-runtime-research\esp-tflite-micro> $base = "C:\Users\nk947\Downloads\robot-runtime-research\esp-tflite-micro\examples\person_detection"

$files = @(
    "w1_raw_output_validation_2026-10-20.csv",
    "w1_reference_kernels_validation_2026-10-20.csv",
    "w1_esp_nn_retest_validation_2026-10-20.csv"
)

foreach ($name in $files) {
    $path = Join-Path $base $name

    Write-Host "`n========================================"
    Write-Host "FILE: $name"
    Write-Host "========================================"

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path)) {
        Write-Host "STATUS: FILE NOT FOUND"
        continue
    }

    $rows = @(Import-Csv -LiteralPath $path)
    $hash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash

    Write-Host "DATA_ROWS=$($rows.Count)"
    Write-Host "SHA256=$hash"

    if ($rows.Count -eq 0) {
        Write-Host "No data rows found."
        continue
    }

    $roundColumn = @(
        $rows[0].PSObject.Properties.Name |
        Where-Object { $_ -match '^(Round|round|round_id)$' }
    ) | Select-Object -First 1

    $imageColumn = @(
        $rows[0].PSObject.Properties.Name |
        Where-Object { $_ -match '^(Image|image_id)$' }
    ) | Select-Object -First 1

    if ($roundColumn -and $imageColumn) {
        $rows |
            Group-Object -Property $roundColumn |
            Sort-Object Name |
            ForEach-Object {
                $images = @(
                    $_.Group |
                    ForEach-Object { $_.PSObject.Properties[$imageColumn].Value } |
                    Sort-Object -Unique
                )

                [PSCustomObject]@{
                    Round       = $_.Name
                    Rows        = $_.Count
                    UniqueImages = $images.Count
                    ImageIDs    = $images -join ","
                }
            } |
            Format-Table -AutoSize
    }
    else {
        Write-Host "Round/Image columns not detected."
        Write-Host "Columns: $($rows[0].PSObject.Properties.Name -join ', ')"
    }
}

    }

$manifest = Join-Path $root `
  "examples\person_detection\w1_latest_firmware_benchmark_1000run_manifest_2026-10-24.csv"

$rows = Import-Csv -LiteralPath $manifest

$results = foreach ($row in $rows) {
    $relativePath = $row.ArtifactPath -replace '^\.[\\/]', ''
    $fullPath = Join-Path $root $relativePath

    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fullPath)) {
        [PSCustomObject]@{
            Artifact = $row.ArtifactPath
            Status   = "MISSING"
            Expected = $row.SHA256
            Actual   = ""
        }
        continue
    }

    try {
        $actualHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $fullPath `
            -Algorithm SHA256 -ErrorAction Stop).Hash.ToUpper()

        $expectedHash = $row.SHA256.ToUpper()

        $status = if ($actualHash -eq $expectedHash) {
            "MATCH"
        } else {
            "MISMATCH"
        }

        [PSCustomObject]@{
            Artifact = $row.ArtifactPath
            Status   = $status
            Expected = $expectedHash
            Actual   = $actualHash
        }
    }
    catch {
        [PSCustomObject]@{
            Artifact = $row.ArtifactPath
            Status   = "READ_ERROR"
            Expected = $row.SHA256
            Actual   = $_.Exception.Message
        }
    }
}

PS C:\Users\nk947\Downloads\robot-runtime-research\esp-tflite-micro> $root = "C:\Users\nk947\Downloads\robot-runtime-research\esp-tflite-micro"
$log = Join-Path $root "examples\person_detection\log.person_detection.20261024224848.txt"

$lines = Get-Content -LiteralPath $log
$sampleLines = @($lines | Where-Object { $_ -match '^BENCH_SAMPLE,' })
$summaryLine = @($lines | Where-Object { $_ -match '^BENCH_SUMMARY,' }) |
    Select-Object -Last 1

$samples = @(
    foreach ($line in $sampleLines) {
        $p = $line.Split(',')

        if ($p.Count -ne 8) {
            throw "Unexpected sample format: $line"
        }

        [PSCustomObject]@{
            Sample   = [int]$p[1]
            ImageID  = [int]$p[2]
            InvokeUs = [long]$p[3]
            Cycles   = [long]$p[4]
            Person   = [int]$p[5]
            NoPerson = [int]$p[6]
            Success  = [int]$p[7]
        }
    }
)

if ($samples.Count -ne 1000) {
    throw "Expected 1000 samples; found $($samples.Count)"
}

if (-not $summaryLine) {
    throw "BENCH_SUMMARY line is missing"
}

$times = @($samples | ForEach-Object { $_.InvokeUs } | Sort-Object)
$mean = [math]::Round(
    ($times | Measure-Object -Average).Average,
    0,
    [MidpointRounding]::AwayFromZero
)
$median = ($times[499] + $times[500]) / 2
$p95 = $times[[int][math]::Ceiling(0.95 * $times.Count) - 1]
$minUs = $times[0]
$maxUs = $times[-1]

$failures = @($samples | Where-Object { $_.Success -ne 1 }).Count
$badSequence = @(
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $samples.Count; $i++) {
        if ($samples[$i].Sample -ne ($i + 1)) { $samples[$i].Sample }
    }
).Count

Write-Host "`n===== INDEPENDENT SAMPLE RECALCULATION ====="
[PSCustomObject]@{
    SampleCount       = $samples.Count
    Failures          = $failures
    InvalidSequence   = $badSequence
    MeanUs            = $mean
    MedianUs          = $median
    P95NearestRankUs  = $p95
    MinimumUs         = $minUs
    MaximumUs         = $maxUs
} | Format-List

Write-Host "`n===== IMAGE COVERAGE ====="
$samples |
    Group-Object ImageID |
    Sort-Object { [int]$_.Name } |
    Select-Object @{N="ImageID";E={$_.Name}}, Count |
    Format-Table -AutoSize

===== THREE-RUNTIME COMPARISON SCRIPT =====
import csv
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path("evidence/cycle_count")
OUT_DETAIL = BASE / "three_runtime_output_pairwise_100run_detail_20261022.csv"
OUT_SUMMARY = BASE / "three_runtime_output_pairwise_100run_summary_20261022.csv"

CONFIGS = {
    "R1_reference": "r1_cycle_benchmark_100_verified_samples_20261022.csv",
    "R2A_ANSI_C": "r2a_cycle_benchmark_100_retry1_samples_20261022.csv",
    "R2_ESP_NN_optimized": "cycle_benchmark_100_retry2_samples_20261022.csv",
}

if OUT_DETAIL.exists() or OUT_SUMMARY.exists():
    raise SystemExit("Output CSV already exists. Refusing to overwrite.")

def read_rows(label, filename):
    path = BASE / filename
    if not path.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"{label}: missing CSV: {path}")

    with path.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
        rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))

    required = {"run", "image", "raw_person", "raw_no_person", "ok"}
    if len(rows) != 100 or not rows or not required.issubset(rows[0]):
        raise SystemExit(f"{label}: unexpected CSV rows or columns")

    if [int(r["run"]) for r in rows] != list(range(1, 101)):
        raise SystemExit(f"{label}: run IDs missing or duplicated")

    return rows

all_rows = {name: read_rows(name, file) for name, file in CONFIGS.items()}

pairs = [
    ("R1_reference", "R2A_ANSI_C"),
    ("R2A_ANSI_C", "R2_ESP_NN_optimized"),
    ("R1_reference", "R2_ESP_NN_optimized"),
]

details, summaries = [], []

for left, right in pairs:
    matched = 0
    image_status = {}

    for a, b in zip(all_rows[left], all_rows[right]):
        differences = []

        for field in ("run", "image", "raw_person", "raw_no_person", "ok"):
            if int(a[field]) != int(b[field]):
                differences.append(field)

        status = "MATCH" if not differences else "MISMATCH"
        matched += status == "MATCH"

        image = int(a["image"])
        image_status.setdefault(image, []).append(status)

        details.append({
            "Pair": f"{left} vs {right}",
            "Run": int(a["run"]),
            "Left_Image": int(a["image"]),
            "Right_Image": int(b["image"]),
            "Left_Person": int(a["raw_person"]),
            "Right_Person": int(b["raw_person"]),
            "Left_NoPerson": int(a["raw_no_person"]),
            "Right_NoPerson": int(b["raw_no_person"]),
            "Left_OK": int(a["ok"]),
            "Right_OK": int(b["ok"]),
            "Mismatch_Fields": ";".join(differences),
            "Status": status,
        })

    image_matches = sum(
        all(status == "MATCH" for status in statuses)
        for statuses in image_status.values()
    )

    summaries.append({
        "Pair": f"{left} vs {right}",
        "Runs_Compared": 100,
        "Matched_Rows": matched,
        "Mismatched_Rows": 100 - matched,
        "Rows_Bit_Exact_Pct": matched,
        "Images_Represented": len(image_status),
        "Images_Matching_All_Repeats": image_matches,
        "Unique_Images_Matching_Pct": (
            round(100 * image_matches / len(image_status), 2)
            if image_status else 0
        ),
        "Result": "MATCH" if matched == 100 else "DIFFERENCES_FOUND",
        "Scope": "10 bundled images cycled; not unique-image validation",
    })

with OUT_DETAIL.open("x", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=list(details[0]))
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(details)

with OUT_SUMMARY.open("x", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=list(summaries[0]))
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(summaries)

print("\nPAIRWISE OUTPUT COMPARISON")
for item in summaries:
    print(
        f'{item["Pair"]}: {item["Matched_Rows"]}/100 rows matched; '
        f'{item["Images_Matching_All_Repeats"]}/'
        f'{item["Images_Represented"]} image IDs match across repeats; '
        f'{item["Result"]}'
    )

print("\nDetail CSV:", OUT_DETAIL)
print("Summary CSV:", OUT_SUMMARY)

        q = t.Quantization()

import csv
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from tensorflow.lite.python import schema_py_generated as schema

MODEL = Path(
    r"C:\Users\nk947\Downloads\robot-runtime-research\tflite-micro"
    r"\tensorflow\lite\micro\models\person_detect.tflite"
)
OUT_DIR = Path(
    r"C:\Users\nk947\Downloads\robot-runtime-research\esp-tflite-micro"
    r"\examples\person_detection\chapter_evidence"
)

OP_CSV = OUT_DIR / "rq1_model_operator_map_2026-10-25.csv"
TENSOR_CSV = OUT_DIR / "rq1_model_tensor_map_2026-10-25.csv"

for path in (OP_CSV, TENSOR_CSV):
    if path.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"Refusing to overwrite existing evidence: {path}")

if not MODEL.is_file():
    raise SystemExit(f"Model file not found: {MODEL}")

raw = MODEL.read_bytes()
model_sha = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest().upper()
model = schema.Model.GetRootAsModel(raw, 0)

if model.SubgraphsLength() < 1:
    raise SystemExit("Model contains no subgraph.")

graph = model.Subgraphs(0)
tensor_count = graph.TensorsLength()
operator_count = graph.OperatorsLength()

def tensor_info(index):
    if index < 0 or index >= tensor_count:
        return {"name": "<optional-or-invalid>", "shape": "", "type": "",
                "buffer": "", "data_bytes": 0, "scale_count": 0, "qdim": ""}

    t = graph.Tensors(index)
    name_raw = t.Name()
    name = name_raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if name_raw else ""
    shape_raw = t.ShapeAsNumpy()
    shape = "x".join(str(int(x)) for x in shape_raw) if shape_raw is not None else ""

    buffer_index = int(t.Buffer())
    buf = model.Buffers(buffer_index)
    data_bytes = int(buf.DataLength()) if buf is not None else 0

    q = t.Quantization()
    scale_count = int(q.ScaleLength()) if q is not None else 0
    qdim = int(q.QuantizedDimension()) if q is not None else ""

    return {
        "name": name.replace(",", ";"),
        "shape": shape,
        "type": int(t.Type()),
        "buffer": buffer_index,
        "data_bytes": data_bytes,
        "scale_count": scale_count,
        "qdim": qdim,
    }

def builtin_code(opcode):
    try:
        return int(opcode.BuiltinCode())
    except Exception:
        return int(opcode.DeprecatedBuiltinCode())

producers = {}
consumers = {i: [] for i in range(tensor_count)}
op_rows = []

for op_index in range(operator_count):
    op = graph.Operators(op_index)
    opcode_index = int(op.OpcodeIndex())
    opcode = model.OperatorCodes(opcode_index)
    code = builtin_code(opcode)

    input_ids = [int(op.Inputs(i)) for i in range(op.InputsLength())]
    output_ids = [int(op.Outputs(i)) for i in range(op.OutputsLength())]

    input_names = []
    for tid in input_ids:
        info = tensor_info(tid)
        input_names.append(f"{tid}:{info['name']}")
        if tid >= 0 and tid < tensor_count:
            consumers[tid].append(op_index)

    output_names = []
    for tid in output_ids:
        info = tensor_info(tid)
        output_names.append(f"{tid}:{info['name']}")
        if tid >= 0 and tid < tensor_count:
            producers[tid] = (op_index, code)

    op_rows.append({
        "operator_index": op_index,
        "opcode_index": opcode_index,
        "builtin_code_numeric": code,
        "operator_version": int(opcode.Version()),
        "input_tensor_indices": ";".join(map(str, input_ids)),
        "input_tensor_names": " | ".join(input_names),
        "output_tensor_indices": ";".join(map(str, output_ids)),
        "output_tensor_names": " | ".join(output_names),
    })

with OP_CSV.open("x", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    fields = list(op_rows[0]) if op_rows else [
        "operator_index", "opcode_index", "builtin_code_numeric",
        "operator_version", "input_tensor_indices", "input_tensor_names",
        "output_tensor_indices", "output_tensor_names"
    ]
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fields)
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(op_rows)

tensor_rows = []
for tensor_index in range(tensor_count):
    info = tensor_info(tensor_index)
    producer_info = producers.get(tensor_index, ("", ""))
    tensor_rows.append({
        "tensor_index": tensor_index,
        "name": info["name"],
        "shape": info["shape"],
        "type_numeric": info["type"],
        "buffer_index": info["buffer"],
        "buffer_data_bytes": info["data_bytes"],
        "has_embedded_buffer_data": info["data_bytes"] > 0,
        "scale_count": info["scale_count"],
        "quantized_dimension": info["qdim"],
        "producer_operator_index": producer_info[0],
        "producer_builtin_code_numeric": producer_info[1],
        "consumer_operator_indices": ";".join(map(str, consumers[tensor_index])),
    })

with TENSOR_CSV.open("x", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    fields = list(tensor_rows[0]) if tensor_rows else []
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fields)
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(tensor_rows)

print(f"MODEL_PATH={MODEL}")
print(f"MODEL_BYTES={len(raw)}")
print(f"MODEL_SHA256={model_sha}")
print(f"SUBGRAPHS={model.SubgraphsLength()}")
print(f"TENSORS={tensor_count}")
print(f"OPERATORS={operator_count}")
print(f"GRAPH_INPUTS={';'.join(str(int(graph.Inputs(i))) for i in range(graph.InputsLength()))}")
print(f"GRAPH_OUTPUTS={';'.join(str(int(graph.Outputs(i))) for i in range(graph.OutputsLength()))}")

for path in (OP_CSV, TENSOR_CSV):
    print(f"OUTPUT={path}")
    print(f"OUTPUT_BYTES={path.stat().st_size}")
    print(f"OUTPUT_SHA256={hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()}")
'@

import hashlib
import re
from pathlib import Path

esp_root = Path(r"C:\Users\nk947\Downloads\robot-runtime-research\esp-tflite-micro")
source_model = Path(r"C:\Users\nk947\Downloads\robot-runtime-research\tflite-micro\tensorflow\lite\micro\models\person_detect.tflite")
search_root = esp_root / "examples" / "person_detection"

if not source_model.is_file():
    raise SystemExit(f"Source model not found: {source_model}")

raw_model = source_model.read_bytes()
source_hash = hashlib.sha256(raw_model).hexdigest().upper()

print(f"SOURCE_MODEL={source_model}")
print(f"SOURCE_MODEL_BYTES={len(raw_model)}")
print(f"SOURCE_MODEL_SHA256={source_hash}")

headers = sorted(search_root.rglob("person_detect_model_data.h"))
headers = [
    p for p in headers
    if not any(part.lower() in {".git", "host-venv", "__pycache__"}
               for part in p.parts)
]

if not headers:
    print("RESULT=NO_EMBEDDED_MODEL_HEADER_FOUND")
    raise SystemExit(0)

pattern = re.compile(
    r"g_person_detect_model_data\s*\[\s*\]\s*[^=]*=\s*\{(.*?)\};",
    re.S
)

for header in headers:
    print("\n--- HEADER ---")
    print(f"HEADER_PATH={header}")

    text = header.read_text(encoding="latin-1")
    match = pattern.search(text)

    if not match:
        print("RESULT=ARRAY_NOT_PARSED")
        continue

    byte_tokens = re.findall(r"0[xX]([0-9a-fA-F]{2})\b", match.group(1))
    embedded = bytes(int(token, 16) for token in byte_tokens)
    embedded_hash = hashlib.sha256(embedded).hexdigest().upper()

    print(f"EMBEDDED_BYTES={len(embedded)}")
    print(f"EMBEDDED_SHA256={embedded_hash}")
    print(f"BYTE_LENGTH_MATCH={len(embedded) == len(raw_model)}")
    print(f"BYTE_HASH_MATCH={embedded_hash == source_hash}")
'@

    re.S

const char* OpNameFromRegistration(const TFLMRegistration* registration) {
  if (registration->builtin_code == BuiltinOperator_CUSTOM) {
    return registration->custom_name;
  } else {
    return EnumNameBuiltinOperator(BuiltinOperator(registration->builtin_code));
  }
}

// Check tensor shapes to determine if there are dynamic tensors present.
// Returns the index of the first dynamic tensor found, otherwise returns -1.
int CheckDynamicTensors(const TfLiteIntArray* const tensor_indices,
                        const TfLiteEvalTensor* const eval_tensors) {
  // some operators have no tensors, so node->inputs and/or node->outputs
  // can be <nullptr>.  This occurs in the MicroInterpreter unit tests.
  if (tensor_indices == nullptr) {
    return -1;
  }

  for (int i = 0; i < tensor_indices->size; i++) {
    const int tensor_index = tensor_indices->data[i];
    // Skip optional tensors
    if (tensor_index < 0) {
      continue;
    }

    // Check shape for dims <= 0.
    const TfLiteEvalTensor* const tp = eval_tensors + tensor_index;
    if (tp->dims->size == 1 && tp->dims->data[0] == 0) {
      // Legacy scalar shapes (dims->size == 1 && dims->data[0] == 0)
      continue;
    }
    // This code can handle scalar tensors (dims->size == 0)
    if (!std::all_of(tp->dims->data, tp->dims->data + tp->dims->size,
                     [](int dim) { return dim > 0; })) {
      return tensor_index;
    }
  }

    static uint32_t rq1_trace_run_id = 0;
    if (invoke_status == kTfLiteOk && subgraph_idx == 0 &&
        current_operator_index_ == 0) {
      ++rq1_trace_run_id;
    }

    if (invoke_status == kTfLiteOk && node->outputs != nullptr) {
      const auto* tensor_vector =
          model_->subgraphs()->Get(subgraph_idx)->tensors();

      for (int output_slot = 0; output_slot < node->outputs->size;
           ++output_slot) {
        const int tensor_index = node->outputs->data[output_slot];

        if (tensor_index < 0 ||
            static_cast<size_t>(tensor_index) >= tensor_vector->size()) {
          MicroPrintf("RQ1_TRACE,run=%u,op=%d,tensor=%d,skip=bad_index",
                      static_cast<unsigned int>(rq1_trace_run_id),
                      static_cast<int>(current_operator_index_), tensor_index);
          continue;
        }

        const TfLiteEvalTensor& trace_tensor =
            subgraph_allocations_[subgraph_idx].tensors[tensor_index];

        if (trace_tensor.type != kTfLiteInt8 ||
            trace_tensor.data.data == nullptr ||
            trace_tensor.dims == nullptr) {
          MicroPrintf("RQ1_TRACE,run=%u,op=%d,tensor=%d,skip=not_int8_or_null",
                      static_cast<unsigned int>(rq1_trace_run_id),
                      static_cast<int>(current_operator_index_), tensor_index);
          continue;
        }

        size_t element_count = 1;
        bool valid_shape = true;
        for (int dim_index = 0; dim_index < trace_tensor.dims->size;
             ++dim_index) {
          const int dim = trace_tensor.dims->data[dim_index];
          if (dim <= 0 ||
              element_count > 1000000u / static_cast<size_t>(dim)) {
            valid_shape = false;
            break;
          }
          element_count *= static_cast<size_t>(dim);
        }

        if (!valid_shape) {
          MicroPrintf("RQ1_TRACE,run=%u,op=%d,tensor=%d,skip=invalid_shape",
                      static_cast<unsigned int>(rq1_trace_run_id),
                      static_cast<int>(current_operator_index_), tensor_index);
          continue;
        }

        const int8_t* values =
            static_cast<const int8_t*>(trace_tensor.data.data);
        int min_value = 127;
        int max_value = -128;
        int32_t sum = 0;
        uint32_t hash = 2166136261u;

        for (size_t i = 0; i < element_count; ++i) {
          const int value = values[i];
          if (value < min_value) min_value = value;
          if (value > max_value) max_value = value;
          sum += static_cast<int32_t>(value);
          hash = (hash ^ static_cast<uint8_t>(values[i])) * 16777619u;
        }

        MicroPrintf(
            "RQ1_TRACE,run=%u,op=%d,tensor=%d,n=%u,min=%d,max=%d,"

            static_cast<unsigned int>(rq1_trace_run_id),
            static_cast<int>(current_operator_index_), tensor_index,
            static_cast<unsigned int>(element_count), min_value, max_value,
            static_cast<int>(sum), static_cast<unsigned int>(hash));

import hashlib
import sys

source = Path(
    r"C:\Users\nk947\Downloads\robot-runtime-research\esp-tflite-micro"
    r"\tensorflow\lite\micro\micro_interpreter_graph.cc"
)
backup = Path(str(source) + ".before_rq1_trace_20261025.bak")

if not source.is_file():
    raise SystemExit(f"SOURCE_NOT_FOUND={source}")
if backup.exists():
    raise SystemExit(f"BACKUP_ALREADY_EXISTS={backup}")

original = source.read_bytes()
if b"TFLM_RQ1_TRACE" in original:
    raise SystemExit("TRACE_MARKER_ALREADY_EXISTS: no changes made")

newline = b"\r\n" if b"\r\n" in original else b"\n"
needle = b"    invoke_status = registration->invoke(context_, node);"

    raise SystemExit(
        "EXPECTED_INVOKE_LINE_COUNT_NOT_ONE: no changes made"

    static uint32_t rq1_trace_run_id = 0;
    if (invoke_status == kTfLiteOk && subgraph_idx == 0 &&
        current_operator_index_ == 0) {
      ++rq1_trace_run_id;
    }

    if (invoke_status == kTfLiteOk && node->outputs != nullptr) {
      const auto* tensor_vector =
          model_->subgraphs()->Get(subgraph_idx)->tensors();

      for (int output_slot = 0; output_slot < node->outputs->size;
           ++output_slot) {
        const int tensor_index = node->outputs->data[output_slot];

        if (tensor_index < 0 ||
            static_cast<size_t>(tensor_index) >= tensor_vector->size()) {
          MicroPrintf("RQ1_TRACE,run=%u,op=%d,tensor=%d,skip=bad_index",
                      static_cast<unsigned int>(rq1_trace_run_id),
                      static_cast<int>(current_operator_index_), tensor_index);
          continue;
        }

        const TfLiteEvalTensor& trace_tensor =
            subgraph_allocations_[subgraph_idx].tensors[tensor_index];

        if (trace_tensor.type != kTfLiteInt8 ||
            trace_tensor.data.data == nullptr ||
            trace_tensor.dims == nullptr) {
          MicroPrintf("RQ1_TRACE,run=%u,op=%d,tensor=%d,skip=not_int8_or_null",
                      static_cast<unsigned int>(rq1_trace_run_id),
                      static_cast<int>(current_operator_index_), tensor_index);

if (-not $ccFiles) {
    "NO_COMPILE_COMMANDS_FOUND"
}

foreach ($ccFile in $ccFiles) {
    try {
        $entries = Get-Content -Raw $ccFile.FullName | ConvertFrom-Json
    }
    catch {
        "JSON_PARSE_ERROR: $($ccFile.FullName)"
        continue
    }

    $matches = $entries | Where-Object {
        $_.file -match 'micro_interpreter_graph\.cc$'
    }

    foreach ($entry in $matches) {
        $sourcePath = [string]$entry.file

        if (-not [System.IO.Path]::IsPathRooted($sourcePath)) {
            $sourcePath = Join-Path ([string]$entry.directory) $sourcePath
        }

        $exists = Test-Path $sourcePath
        $hasTrace = $false

        if ($exists) {
            $hasTrace = [bool](Select-String -LiteralPath $sourcePath `
                -Pattern 'TFLM_RQ1_TRACE|RQ1_TRACE' -Quiet)
        }

        [PSCustomObject]@{
            CompileDatabase   = $ccFile.FullName
            Source            = $sourcePath
            SourceExists      = $exists
            TraceMacroPresent = $hasTrace
        } | Format-List
    }
}

                SHA256     = $hash
                ExactMatch = ($hash -eq $expectedHash)
            }
        }
}

if ($candidates) {
    $candidates | Format-List
} else {
    "NO_SAME_SIZE_BIN_CANDIDATE_FOUND_IN_ADDITIONAL_ROOTS"
}

// This function implements the same computation as the ARMv7 NEON VQRDMULH
// instruction.
template <>
inline std::int32_t SaturatingRoundingDoublingHighMul(std::int32_t a,
                                                      std::int32_t b) {
  bool overflow = a == b && a == std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::min();
  std::int64_t a_64(a);
  std::int64_t b_64(b);
  std::int64_t ab_64 = a_64 * b_64;
  std::int32_t nudge = ab_64 >= 0 ? (1 << 30) : (1 - (1 << 30));
  std::int32_t ab_x2_high32 =
      static_cast<std::int32_t>((ab_64 + nudge) / (1ll << 31));
  return overflow ? std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max() : ab_x2_high32;
}

Line 356: inline IntegerType RoundingDivideByPOT(IntegerType x, int exponent) {

// Correctly-rounded-to-nearest division by a power-of-two.
// Also known as a rounding arithmetic right shift.
template <typename IntegerType>
inline IntegerType RoundingDivideByPOT(IntegerType x, int exponent) {
  assert(exponent >= 0);
  assert(exponent <= 31);
  const IntegerType mask = Dup<IntegerType>((1ll << exponent) - 1);
  const IntegerType zero = Dup<IntegerType>(0);
  const IntegerType one = Dup<IntegerType>(1);
  const IntegerType remainder = BitAnd(x, mask);
  const IntegerType threshold =
      Add(ShiftRight(mask, 1), BitAnd(MaskIfLessThan(x, zero), one));
  return Add(ShiftRight(x, exponent),
             BitAnd(MaskIfGreaterThan(remainder, threshold), one));

// Note on TFLITE_NO_SANITIZE_INTEGER_OVERFLOW below:
//
// These MultiplyByQuantizedMultiplier overloads do not intentionally wrap, so
// they deliberately do NOT use WrappingMul/WrappingAdd. Under their documented
// input contract (asserted below) the arithmetic does not overflow; the
// attribute only silences UBSan reports at the contract's boundaries. Using
// wrapping here would be wrong -- it would mask a contract violation (a real
// bug) instead of letting it surface.

// Single-rounding MultiplyByQuantizedMultiplier
#if TFLITE_SINGLE_ROUNDING
TFLITE_NO_SANITIZE_INTEGER_OVERFLOW
int32_t MultiplyByQuantizedMultiplier(int32_t x, int32_t quantized_multiplier,
                                      int shift) {
  TFLITE_DCHECK(quantized_multiplier >= 0);
  TFLITE_DCHECK(shift >= -31 && shift <= 30);

  const int64_t total_shift = 31 - shift;
  const int64_t round = static_cast<int64_t>(1) << (total_shift - 1);
  int64_t result = x * static_cast<int64_t>(quantized_multiplier) + round;
  result = result >> total_shift;

  TFLITE_DCHECK(result >= std::numeric_limits<int32_t>::min() &&
                result <= std::numeric_limits<int32_t>::max());
  return static_cast<int32_t>(result);
}

TFLITE_NO_SANITIZE_INTEGER_OVERFLOW
int32_t MultiplyByQuantizedMultiplier(int64_t x, int32_t quantized_multiplier,
                                      int shift) {
  // Inputs:
  // - quantized_multiplier has fixed point at bit 31
  // - shift is -31 to +7 (negative for right shift)
  //
  // Assumptions: The following input ranges are assumed
  // - quantize_scale>=0  (the usual range is (1<<30) to (1>>31)-1)
  // - scaling is chosen so final scaled result fits in int32_t
  // - input x is in the range -(1<<47) <= x < (1<<47)
  TFLITE_DCHECK(quantized_multiplier >= 0);
  TFLITE_DCHECK(shift >= -31 && shift < 8);
  TFLITE_DCHECK(x >= -(static_cast<int64_t>(1) << 47) &&
                x < (static_cast<int64_t>(1) << 47));

  const int32_t reduced_multiplier =
      (quantized_multiplier < 0x7FFF0000)
          ? ((quantized_multiplier + (1 << 15)) >> 16)
          : 0x7FFF;
  const int64_t total_shift = 15 - shift;
  const int64_t round = static_cast<int64_t>(1) << (total_shift - 1);
  int64_t result = x * static_cast<int64_t>(reduced_multiplier) + round;
  result = result >> total_shift;

  TFLITE_DCHECK(result >= std::numeric_limits<int32_t>::min() &&
                result <= std::numeric_limits<int32_t>::max());
  return static_cast<int32_t>(result);
}
// Double-rounding MultiplyByQuantizedMultiplier
#else
TFLITE_NO_SANITIZE_INTEGER_OVERFLOW
int32_t MultiplyByQuantizedMultiplier(int32_t x, int32_t quantized_multiplier,
                                      int shift) {
  int left_shift = shift > 0 ? shift : 0;
  int right_shift = shift > 0 ? 0 : -shift;
  return RoundingDivideByPOT(SaturatingRoundingDoublingHighMul(
                                 x * (1 << left_shift), quantized_multiplier),
                             right_shift);
}

TFLITE_NO_SANITIZE_INTEGER_OVERFLOW
int32_t MultiplyByQuantizedMultiplier(int64_t x, int32_t quantized_multiplier,
                                      int shift) {
  // Inputs:
  // - quantized_multiplier has fixed point at bit 31
  // - shift is -31 to +7 (negative for right shift)
  //
  // Assumptions: The following input ranges are assumed
  // - quantize_scale>=0  (the usual range is (1<<30) to (1>>31)-1)
  // - scaling is chosen so final scaled result fits in int32_t
  // - input x is in the range -(1<<47) <= x < (1<<47)
  assert(quantized_multiplier >= 0);
  assert(shift >= -31 && shift < 8);
  assert(x >= -(static_cast<int64_t>(1) << 47) &&
         x < (static_cast<int64_t>(1) << 47));

  int32_t reduced_multiplier = (quantized_multiplier < 0x7FFF0000)
                                   ? ((quantized_multiplier + (1 << 15)) >> 16)
                                   : 0x7FFF;
  int total_shift = 15 - shift;
  x = (x * (int64_t)reduced_multiplier) + ((int64_t)1 << (total_shift - 1));
  int32_t result = x >> total_shift;
  return result;
}

#include <cstdint>
#include <iostream>
#include "tensorflow/lite/micro/kernels/internal/common.h"

int main() {
    struct Test {
        const char* name;
        int32_t x;
        int32_t multiplier;
        int shift;
        int32_t expected;
    };

#if TFLITE_SINGLE_ROUNDING
    const Test tests[] = {
        {"positive_half", 3, 1073741824, 0, 2},
        {"negative_half", -3, 1073741824, 0, -1},
        {"positive_boundary", 3, 2147483647, -1, 1},
        {"negative_boundary", -3, 2147483647, -1, -1},
        {"positive_five", 5, 1073741824, 0, 3},
        {"negative_five", -5, 1073741824, 0, -2}
    };
#else
    const Test tests[] = {
        {"positive_half", 3, 1073741824, 0, 2},
        {"negative_half", -3, 1073741824, 0, -1},
        {"positive_boundary", 3, 2147483647, -1, 2},
        {"negative_boundary", -3, 2147483647, -1, -2},
        {"positive_five", 5, 1073741824, 0, 3},
        {"negative_five", -5, 1073741824, 0, -2}
    };
#endif

    int failures = 0;

    for (const auto& t : tests) {
        const int32_t actual =
            tflite::micro::MultiplyByQuantizedMultiplier(
                t.x, t.multiplier, t.shift);

        const bool pass = actual == t.expected;

        std::cout << (pass ? "PASS " : "FAIL ")
                  << t.name
                  << " expected=" << t.expected
                  << " actual=" << actual << '\n';

        if (!pass) ++failures;
    }

    std::cout << "TESTS=" << sizeof(tests) / sizeof(tests[0])
              << " FAILURES=" << failures << '\n';

    return failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}
'@

#include "tensorflow/lite/micro/kernels/internal/common.h"

int main() {
    struct Test {
        const char* name;
        int32_t x;
        int32_t multiplier;
        int shift;
        int32_t expected;
    };

#if TFLITE_SINGLE_ROUNDING
    const Test tests[] = {
        {"positive_half", 3, 1073741824, 0, 2},
        {"negative_half", -3, 1073741824, 0, -1},
        {"positive_rounding_boundary", 3, 2147483647, -1, 2},
        {"negative_rounding_boundary", -3, 2147483647, -1, -1},
        {"positive_five", 5, 1073741824, 0, 3},
        {"negative_five", -5, 1073741824, 0, -2}
    };
#else
    const Test tests[] = {
        {"positive_half", 3, 1073741824, 0, 2},
        {"negative_half", -3, 1073741824, 0, -1},
        {"positive_rounding_boundary", 3, 2147483647, -1, 2},
        {"negative_rounding_boundary", -3, 2147483647, -1, -2},
        {"positive_five", 5, 1073741824, 0, 3},
        {"negative_five", -5, 1073741824, 0, -2}
    };
#endif

    int failures = 0;

    for (const auto& t : tests) {
        const int32_t actual =
            tflite::micro::MultiplyByQuantizedMultiplier(
                t.x, t.multiplier, t.shift);

        const bool pass = actual == t.expected;

        std::cout << (pass ? "PASS " : "FAIL ")
                  << t.name
                  << " expected=" << t.expected
                  << " actual=" << actual << '\n';

        if (!pass) ++failures;
    }

    std::cout << "TESTS=" << sizeof(tests) / sizeof(tests[0])
              << " FAILURES=" << failures << '\n';

    return failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}

    $mutant = $original

    if ($mode -eq 1) {
        # Inject +1 into the single-rounding int32 path.
        $old = "result = result >> total_shift;"
        $idx = $mutant.IndexOf($old)

        if ($idx -lt 0) { throw "Single-rounding mutation point not found." }

        $new = "result = (result >> total_shift) + 1;"
        $mutant = $mutant.Remove($idx, $old.Length).Insert($idx, $new)
    }
    else {
        # Inject +1 into the double-rounding int32 path.
        $marker = "// Double-rounding MultiplyByQuantizedMultiplier"
        $blockStart = $mutant.IndexOf($marker)

        if ($blockStart -lt 0) { throw "Double-rounding block not found." }

        $needle = "return RoundingDivideByPOT(SaturatingRoundingDoublingHighMul("
        $idx = $mutant.IndexOf($needle, $blockStart)

        if ($idx -lt 0) { throw "Double-rounding mutation point not found." }

        $tail = $mutant.IndexOf("right_shift);", $idx)

        if ($tail -lt 0) { throw "Double-rounding return tail not found." }

        $old = "right_shift);"
        $new = "right_shift) + 1;"
        $mutant = $mutant.Remove($tail, $old.Length).Insert($tail, $new)
    }

    $mutantFile = Join-Path $env:TEMP "rq4_mutant_common_mode$mode.cc"
    $exe = Join-Path $env:TEMP "rq4_mutant_kat_mode$mode.exe"

    Set-Content -LiteralPath $mutantFile -Value $mutant -Encoding Ascii

    "`n=== MUTANT TEST: ROUNDING MODE $mode ==="

    & $compiler -std=c++17 "-DTFLITE_SINGLE_ROUNDING=$mode" `
        "-I$repo" $src $mutantFile -o $exe

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        "MUTANT_COMPILE_FAILED mode=$mode"
        continue
    }

    & $exe
    $testRC = $LASTEXITCODE

    "MUTANT_TEST_EXIT_CODE=$testRC"

    if ($testRC -ne 0) {
        "MUTANT_DETECTED mode=$mode"
    } else {
        "MUTANT_NOT_DETECTED mode=$mode"
    }
}

$code = @'
#include <cstdint>
#include <iostream>
#include <limits>
#include "tensorflow/lite/micro/kernels/internal/common.h"

int main() {
    int failures = 0;

    struct MulTest {
        const char* name;
        int32_t a, b, expected;
    };

    const MulTest mul[] = {
        {"min_min_saturation",
         INT32_MIN, INT32_MIN, INT32_MAX},
        {"max_max",
         INT32_MAX, INT32_MAX, 2147483646},
        {"positive_half_scale",
         1073741824, 1073741824, 536870912},
        {"negative_half_scale",
         -1073741824, 1073741824, -536870912}
    };

    for (const auto& t : mul) {
        int32_t actual =
            tflite::micro::SaturatingRoundingDoublingHighMul(t.a, t.b);
        bool ok = actual == t.expected;
        std::cout << (ok ? "PASS " : "FAIL ")
                  << t.name << " expected=" << t.expected
                  << " actual=" << actual << '\n';
        if (!ok) ++failures;
    }

    struct DivTest {
        const char* name;
        int32_t x;
        int exponent;
        int32_t expected;
    };

    const DivTest div[] = {
        {"positive_tie", 7, 1, 4},
        {"negative_tie", -7, 1, -4},
        {"positive_half", 6, 2, 2},
        {"negative_half", -6, 2, -2},
        {"positive_fraction", 5, 2, 1},
        {"negative_fraction", -5, 2, -1},
        {"min_div_2pow31", INT32_MIN, 31, -1},
        {"max_div_2pow31", INT32_MAX, 31, 1}
    };

    for (const auto& t : div) {
        int32_t actual =
            tflite::micro::RoundingDivideByPOT(t.x, t.exponent);
        bool ok = actual == t.expected;
        std::cout << (ok ? "PASS " : "FAIL ")
                  << t.name << " expected=" << t.expected
                  << " actual=" << actual << '\n';
        if (!ok) ++failures;
    }

    std::cout << "TESTS="
              << (sizeof(mul) / sizeof(mul[0]) +
                  sizeof(div) / sizeof(div[0]))
              << " FAILURES=" << failures << '\n';

    return failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}
'@

$repo = "C:\Users\nk947\Downloads\robot-runtime-research\tflite-micro"

$sourceTest = Join-Path $env:TEMP "rq4_direct_primitives_kat.cpp"

$headerDir = "$repo\tensorflow\lite\micro\kernels\internal"

foreach ($kind in @("highmul", "rounddivide")) {
    $overlay = Join-Path $env:TEMP "rq4_mutant_overlay_$kind"
    $internal = Join-Path $overlay "tensorflow\lite\micro\kernels\internal"

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $internal -Force | Out-Null
    Copy-Item $commonOriginal (Join-Path $internal "common.h") -Force
    Copy-Item $fixedOriginal (Join-Path $internal "fixedpoint.h") -Force

    $headerPath = Join-Path $internal "fixedpoint.h"
    $content = Get-Content -LiteralPath $headerPath -Raw

    if ($kind -eq "highmul") {
        $old = 'return overflow ? std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max() : ab_x2_high32;'
        $new = 'return overflow ? std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max() : (ab_x2_high32 + 1);'

        if (!$content.Contains($old)) {
            throw "HighMul mutation point not found; no test was run."
        }

        $content = $content.Replace($old, $new)
    }
    else {
        $pattern = 'return Add\(ShiftRight\(x, exponent\),\s*BitAnd\(MaskIfGreaterThan\(remainder, threshold\), one\)\);'
        $regex = [regex]::new($pattern)

        if ($regex.Matches($content).Count -ne 1) {
            throw "RoundingDivideByPOT mutation point not uniquely identified; no test was run."
        }

        $replacement = 'return Add(Add(ShiftRight(x, exponent), BitAnd(MaskIfGreaterThan(remainder, threshold), one)), one);'
        $content = $regex.Replace($content, $replacement, 1)
    }

    Set-Content -LiteralPath $headerPath -Value $content -Encoding Ascii

    $exe = Join-Path $env:TEMP "rq4_direct_mutant_$kind.exe"

    "`n=== DIRECT PRIMITIVE MUTANT: $kind ==="

    & $compiler -std=c++17 "-I$overlay" "-I$repo" $sourceTest -o $exe

    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        "MUTANT_COMPILE_FAILED kind=$kind"
        continue
    }

    $output = & $exe 2>&1
    $testRC = $LASTEXITCODE

    if ($output) { $output }

    "MUTANT_TEST_EXIT_CODE=$testRC"

    if ($testRC -ne 0) {
        "MUTANT_DETECTED kind=$kind"
    }
    else {
        "MUTANT_NOT_DETECTED kind=$kind"
    }
}

PS C:\Users\nk947\Downloads\robot-runtime-research\tflite-micro> $pd = "C:\Users\nk947\Downloads\robot-runtime-research\esp-tflite-micro\examples\person_detection"

$builds = @(
    @{
        Name = "R1_TRACE"
        Path = "$pd\build_rq1_tensor_trace_r1_20261025"
    },
    @{
        Name = "R2_OPTIMIZED"
        Path = "$pd\build_rq1_tensor_trace_r2_optimized_20261025"
    }
)

$sourceSets = @{}

foreach ($item in $builds) {
    "`n========== $($item.Name) =========="

    $db = Join-Path $item.Path "compile_commands.json"
    $cfg = Join-Path $item.Path "config\sdkconfig.h"

    if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $db)) {
        "COMPILE_DATABASE_NOT_FOUND"
        continue
    }

    $entries = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $db -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)
    "TOTAL_COMPILE_ENTRIES=$($entries.Count)"

    $sources = @(
        $entries |
            Where-Object {
                $_.file -match '(?i)espressif__esp-nn' -and
                $_.file -match '(?i)(multiply_by_quantized|conv_opt|conv_ansi|depthwise_conv_opt|depthwise_conv_ansi|conv_esp32s3|depthwise_conv_s8)'
            } |
            ForEach-Object {
                $_.file -replace '/', '\'
            } |
            Sort-Object -Unique
    )

    $sourceSets[$item.Name] = $sources

    "`n--- Relevant compiled ESP-NN source files ---"

    if ($sources.Count -gt 0) {
        $sources | ForEach-Object { $_ }
    } else {
        "NO_MATCHING_ESP_NN_SOURCE_ENTRIES"
    }

    "`n--- Generated configuration ---"

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $cfg) {
        Select-String -LiteralPath $cfg `
            -Pattern 'CONFIG_ESP_TFLITE_MICRO_USE_ESP_NN|CONFIG_NN_OPTIMIZED|CONFIG_NN_OPTIMIZATIONS|CONFIG_IDF_TARGET=' |
            ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() }
    } else {
        "SDKCONFIG_HEADER_NOT_FOUND"
    }
}

"`n========== SOURCE SET DIFFERENCES =========="

if ($sourceSets.ContainsKey("R1_TRACE") -and
    $sourceSets.ContainsKey("R2_OPTIMIZED")) {

    Compare-Object $sourceSets["R1_TRACE"] $sourceSets["R2_OPTIMIZED"] |
        ForEach-Object {
            $label = if ($_.SideIndicator -eq "<=") {
                "R1_ONLY"
            } else {
                "R2_ONLY"
            }

            "$label : $($_.InputObject)"
        }
}

    "`n========== $($item.Name) =========="

    $db = Join-Path $item.Path "compile_commands.json"
    $cfg = Join-Path $item.Path "config\sdkconfig.h"

    if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $db)) {
        "COMPILE_DATABASE_NOT_FOUND"
        continue
    }

    # Wrap the JSON array so PowerShell preserves its individual records.
    $raw = Get-Content -LiteralPath $db -Raw
    $doc = ConvertFrom-Json -InputObject ('{"entries":' + $raw + '}')
    $entries = @($doc.entries)

    "TOTAL_COMPILE_ENTRIES=$($entries.Count)"

    $nnEntries = @(
        foreach ($entry in $entries) {
            if ([string]$entry.file -match '(?i)managed_components[/\\]espressif__esp-nn[/\\]') {
                $entry
            }
        }
    )

    "ESP_NN_COMPILE_ENTRIES=$($nnEntries.Count)"

    $relevant = @(
        foreach ($entry in $nnEntries) {
            $file = [string]$entry.file

            if ($file -match '(?i)(multiply_by_quantized|conv_opt|conv_ansi|depthwise_conv_opt|depthwise_conv_ansi|conv_esp32s3|depthwise_conv_s8)') {
                $file -replace '/', '\'
            }
        }
    ) | Sort-Object -Unique

    $sourceSets[$item.Name] = @($relevant)

    "`n--- Relevant ESP-NN source files ---"
    if ($relevant.Count -gt 0) {
        $relevant
    } else {
        "NO_RELEVANT_ESP_NN_SOURCE_ENTRIES"
    }

    "`n--- Generated configuration ---"
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $cfg) {
        Select-String -LiteralPath $cfg `
            -Pattern 'CONFIG_ESP_TFLITE_MICRO_USE_ESP_NN|CONFIG_NN_OPTIMIZED|CONFIG_NN_OPTIMIZATIONS|CONFIG_IDF_TARGET=' |
            ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() }
    } else {
        "SDKCONFIG_HEADER_NOT_FOUND"
    }
}

=== ESP-NN REQUANTIZATION SELECTION ===
    int32_t result;

    const int32_t mask = (1 << exponent) - 1;
    const int32_t remainder = val & mask;

    result = val >> exponent;
    int32_t threshold = (mask >> 1) + (result < 0);

    if (remainder > threshold) {
        result += 1;
    }
    return result;
}

__NN_FORCE_INLINE__ int32_t esp_nn_multiply_by_quantized_mult(int32_t x, int32_t mult, int32_t shift)
{
    int32_t left_shift = shift > 0 ? shift : 0;
    int32_t right_shift = shift > 0 ? 0 : -shift;
    int32_t result = esp_nn_sat_round_doubling_high_mul(x * (1 << left_shift), mult);
    return esp_nn_div_by_power_of_two(result, right_shift);
}

/** PIE enable macro - call once before using any esp.* instructions */
#define ESP_NN_PIE_ENABLE() do { \
    asm volatile ( \
        "csrsi  0x7f2, 0b01        \n\t" \
        "li     x29, 0b10          \n\t" \
        "esp.movx.w.cfg x29        \n\t" \
        ::: "x29" \
    ); \
} while(0)

/** Extract 16 int32 per-lane results from QACC into array */
#define ESP_NN_QACC_EXTRACT_S32(dst) do { \
    asm volatile ( \
        "mv                      x30, %0     \n\t" \
        "esp.st.qacc.l.l.128.ip  x30, 16     \n\t" \
        "esp.st.qacc.l.h.128.ip  x30, 16     \n\t" \
        "esp.st.qacc.h.l.128.ip  x30, 16     \n\t" \
        "esp.st.qacc.h.h.128.ip  x30, 0      \n\t" \

/**
 * 2-wide interleaved requant macro for ESP32-P4 RISC-V.
 * Interleaves mulh across two independent elements for pipeline fill.
 * Outputs r0, r1 as requantized int32 values (before offset/clamp).
 */
#if CONFIG_IDF_TARGET_ESP32P4 || CONFIG_IDF_TARGET_ESP32S31
#define ESP_NN_REQUANT_2X(x0, x1, m0, m1, s0, s1, r0, r1) do { \
    int32_t _ls0 = (s0) > 0 ? (s0) : 0; \
    int32_t _ls1 = (s1) > 0 ? (s1) : 0; \
    int32_t _v0 = (x0) << _ls0; \
    int32_t _v1 = (x1) << _ls1; \
    int32_t _rs0 = _ls0 - (s0); \
    int32_t _rs1 = _ls1 - (s1); \
    int32_t _hi0, _lo0, _hi1, _lo1; \
    asm volatile ( \
        "mulh  %[h0], %[v0], %[mm0]  \n\t" \
        "mulh  %[h1], %[v1], %[mm1]  \n\t" \
        "mul   %[l0], %[v0], %[mm0]  \n\t" \
        "mul   %[l1], %[v1], %[mm1]  \n\t" \
        : [h0] "=&r"(_hi0), [h1] "=&r"(_hi1), \
          [l0] "=&r"(_lo0), [l1] "=&r"(_lo1) \
        : [v0] "r"(_v0), [v1] "r"(_v1), \
          [mm0] "r"((int32_t)(m0)), [mm1] "r"((int32_t)(m1)) \
    ); \
    /* Add nudge (1<<30) and extract bits [31:62] */ \
    uint32_t _n = 0x40000000u; \
    uint32_t _a0 = (uint32_t)_lo0 + _n; \
    _hi0 += (_a0 < (uint32_t)_lo0); \
    (r0) = (_hi0 << 1) | (_a0 >> 31); \
    uint32_t _a1 = (uint32_t)_lo1 + _n; \
    _hi1 += (_a1 < (uint32_t)_lo1); \
    (r1) = (_hi1 << 1) | (_a1 >> 31); \
    /* Right shift with rounding */ \
    if (_rs0) { (r0) = ((r0) + (1 << (_rs0 - 1)) - ((r0) < 0)) >> _rs0; } \
    if (_rs1) { (r1) = ((r1) + (1 << (_rs1 - 1)) - ((r1) < 0)) >> _rs1; } \
} while(0)
#endif

__NN_FORCE_INLINE__ int32_t esp_nn_multiply_by_quantized_mult_fast(int32_t x, int32_t mult, int32_t shift)
{
    int32_t left_shift = max(shift, 0);
    int32_t right_shift = left_shift - shift;

    int64_t nudge_val = 1 << 30;
    int64_t in0_64 = (int64_t) (x << left_shift);

    /* Multiply and add nudge */
    int64_t mult_64 = in0_64 * mult + nudge_val;
    int32_t result = (int32_t) (mult_64 >> 31);
    if (right_shift) {
        result = esp_nn_div_by_power_of_two_fast(result, right_shift);
    }
    return result;
}

/*
 * Unified requantize wrapper. Defining either SKIP_NUDGE (legacy) or
 * CONFIG_NN_SKIP_NUDGE (Kconfig-driven) selects the faster, non-bit-exact
 * path; otherwise the bit-exact TFLite-reference path is used.
 */
#if defined(SKIP_NUDGE) || defined(CONFIG_NN_SKIP_NUDGE)
#define esp_nn_requantize(x, m, s) esp_nn_multiply_by_quantized_mult_fast((x), (m), (s))
#else
#define esp_nn_requantize(x, m, s) esp_nn_multiply_by_quantized_mult((x), (m), (s))
#endif

static void esp_nn_aligned_s8_pad_with_value(const int8_t *src, int8_t *dst,

                                             const uint16_t channels,
                                             const int32_t pad_val,
                                             const uint16_t pad_wd,
                                             const uint16_t pad_ht)
{
    /* memset with pad_val */
    memset(dst, pad_val, ((input_wd + 2 * pad_wd) * (input_ht + 2 * pad_ht)) * channels);
    dst += (pad_wd + input_wd + pad_wd) * pad_ht * channels;

extern "C" {
volatile int g_benchmark_mode = 0;

namespace {
const tflite::Model* model = nullptr;
tflite::MicroInterpreter* interpreter = nullptr;
TfLiteTensor* input = nullptr;

// In order to use optimized tensorflow lite kernels, a signed int8_t quantized
// model is preferred over the legacy unsigned model format. This means that
// throughout this project, input images must be converted from unisgned to
// signed format. The easiest and quickest way to convert from unsigned to
// signed 8-bit integers is to subtract 128 from the unsigned value to get a
// signed value.

#if CONFIG_NN_OPTIMIZED
constexpr int scratchBufSize = 60 * 1024;
#else
constexpr int scratchBufSize = 0;
#endif
// An area of memory to use for input, output, and intermediate arrays.
// Keeping allocation on bit larger size to accomodate future needs.
constexpr int kTensorArenaSize = 100 * 1024 + scratchBufSize;
static uint8_t *tensor_arena;//[kTensorArenaSize]; // Maybe we should move this to external
}  // namespace

void setup() {
  // Map the model into a usable data structure. This doesn't involve any
  // copying or parsing, it's a very lightweight operation.
  model = tflite::GetModel(g_person_detect_model_data);
  if (model->version() != TFLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION) {
    MicroPrintf("Model provided is schema version %d not equal to supported "
                "version %d.", model->version(), TFLITE_SCHEMA_VERSION);
    return;
  }

  if (tensor_arena == NULL) {
    // prefer PSRAM, fall back to internal RAM on targets/boards without it
    tensor_arena = (uint8_t *) heap_caps_malloc_prefer(kTensorArenaSize, 2,
                                                       MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM | MALLOC_CAP_8BIT,
                                                       MALLOC_CAP_8BIT);
  }
  if (tensor_arena == NULL) {
    printf("Couldn't allocate memory of %d bytes\n", kTensorArenaSize);
    return;
  }

  // Pull in only the operation implementations we need.
  // This relies on a complete list of all the ops needed by this graph.
  // An easier approach is to just use the AllOpsResolver, but this will
  // incur some penalty in code space for op implementations that are not
  // needed by this graph.
  //
  // tflite::AllOpsResolver resolver;
  // NOLINTNEXTLINE(runtime-global-variables)
  static tflite::MicroMutableOpResolver<5> micro_op_resolver;
  micro_op_resolver.AddAveragePool2D();
  micro_op_resolver.AddConv2D();
  micro_op_resolver.AddDepthwiseConv2D();
  micro_op_resolver.AddReshape();
  micro_op_resolver.AddSoftmax();

  // Build an interpreter to run the model with.
  // NOLINTNEXTLINE(runtime-global-variables)
  static tflite::MicroInterpreter static_interpreter(
      model, micro_op_resolver, tensor_arena, kTensorArenaSize);
  interpreter = &static_interpreter;

$builds = @(
    @{ Name = "R1_TRACE"; Path = "$pd\build_rq1_tensor_trace_r1_20261025" },
    @{ Name = "R2_OPTIMIZED"; Path = "$pd\build_rq1_tensor_trace_r2_optimized_20261025" }
)

foreach ($b in $builds) {
    "`n========== $($b.Name) =========="

    $db = Join-Path $b.Path "compile_commands.json"
    $raw = Get-Content -LiteralPath $db -Raw
    $doc = ConvertFrom-Json -InputObject ('{"entries":' + $raw + '}')
    $entries = @($doc.entries)

    $commonEntries = @(
        $entries | Where-Object {
            [string]$_.file -match '(?i)\\tensorflow\\lite\\micro\\kernels\\internal\\common\.cc$'
        }
    )

    "COMMON_CC_ENTRIES=$($commonEntries.Count)"

    foreach ($entry in $commonEntries) {
        $cmd = [string]$entry.command
        $hits = [regex]::Matches(
            $cmd,
            '(?<!\S)-D\s*(TFLITE_SINGLE_ROUNDING(?:=[^\s]+)?)'
        )
        $defs = @(
            foreach ($hit in $hits) { $hit.Groups[1].Value }
        )
        "COMMON_CC_ROUNDING_DEFINE=$($defs -join ',')"
    }

    $flags = Join-Path $b.Path "toolchain\cflags"
    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $flags) {
        $flagText = Get-Content -LiteralPath $flags -Raw
        $flagHits = [regex]::Matches(
            $flagText,
            '(?<!\S)-D\s*(TFLITE_SINGLE_ROUNDING(?:=[^\s]+)?)'
        )
        $defs = @(
            foreach ($hit in $flagHits) { $hit.Groups[1].Value }
        )
        "RESPONSE_FILE_ROUNDING_DEFINE=$($defs -join ',')"
    }

    $configHits = @(
        Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $b.Path "config") -File -Recurse `
            -Include *.h -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
            Select-String -Pattern 'TFLITE_SINGLE_ROUNDING' |
            ForEach-Object {
                "$($_.Path):$($_.LineNumber):$($_.Line.Trim())"
            }
    )
    "GENERATED_CONFIG=$($configHits -join '; ')"
}

            $found = $true
            "SOURCE=$([string]$entry.file)"

                }
        }
    }

--- Rounding macro in source/config files ---
PS C:\Users\nk947\Downloads\robot-runtime-research\tflite-micro> $pd = "C:\Users\nk947\Downloads\robot-runtime-research\esp-tflite-micro\examples\person_detection"

$builds = @(
    @{ Name = "R1_TRACE"; Path = "$pd\build_rq1_tensor_trace_r1_20261025" },
    @{ Name = "R2_OPTIMIZED"; Path = "$pd\build_rq1_tensor_trace_r2_optimized_20261025" }
)

foreach ($b in $builds) {
    "`n========== $($b.Name) =========="

    $db = Join-Path $b.Path "compile_commands.json"
    $raw = Get-Content -LiteralPath $db -Raw
    $doc = ConvertFrom-Json -InputObject ('{"entries":' + $raw + '}')
    $entries = @($doc.entries)

    $entry = $entries |
        Where-Object {
            [string]$_.file -match '\\tensorflow\\lite\\kernels\\internal\\common\.cc$'
        } |
        Select-Object -First 1

    if ($null -eq $entry) {
        "ACTUAL_COMMON_CC_ENTRY=NOT_FOUND"
        continue
    }

    "ACTUAL_COMMON_CC=$($entry.file)"

    $cmd = [string]$entry.command
    $macroHits = [regex]::Matches(
        $cmd,
        '(?<!\S)-D\s*(TFLITE_SINGLE_ROUNDING(?:=[^\s]+)?)'
    )

    $macroDefs = @(
        foreach ($hit in $macroHits) { $hit.Groups[1].Value }
    )
    "COMPILER_ROUNDING_FLAGS=$($macroDefs -join ',')"

    "`n--- Actual source conditions ---"
    Select-String -LiteralPath ([string]$entry.file) `
        -Pattern 'TFLITE_SINGLE_ROUNDING|MultiplyByQuantizedMultiplier' `
        -Context 3,8
}

"`n=== Definitions across the TFLite source tree ==="

$root = "C:\Users\nk947\Downloads\robot-runtime-research\esp-tflite-micro\tensorflow\lite"

Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $root -Recurse -File `

    -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    ForEach-Object {
        "{0}:{1}: {2}" -f $_.Path, $_.LineNumber, $_.Line.Trim()
    }

#pragma once

#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <string.h>

/**
 * c99 standard still doesn't strictly inline functions
 * We need to use attribute as well to do this.
 */
#define __NN_FORCE_INLINE__ __attribute((always_inline)) static inline

/* min/max macros */
#ifndef max
#define max(a, b) ({            \
    __typeof__ (a) _a = (a);    \
    __typeof__ (b) _b = (b);    \
    _a > _b ? _a : _b;          \
})

#define min(a, b) ({            \
    __typeof__ (a) _a = (a);    \
    __typeof__ (b) _b = (b);    \
    _a < _b ? _a : _b;          \
})
#endif

__NN_FORCE_INLINE__ int32_t esp_nn_clz32(uint32_t in)
{
#if CONFIG_IDF_TARGET_ARCH_XTENSA
    __asm__ volatile("nsau %0, %0" : "+r" (in));
    return in;
#elif defined(__GNUC__)
    return __builtin_clz(in);
#else
    int32_t count = 32;
    uint32_t x = in, y = in >> 16;
    if (y != 0) {
        count -= 16;
        x = y;
    }
    y = x >> 8;
    if (y != 0) {
        count -= 8;
        x = y;
    }
    y = x >> 4;
    if (y != 0) {
        count -= 4;
        x = y;
    }
    y = x >> 2;
    if (y != 0) {
        count -= 2;
        x = y;
    }
    y = x >> 1;
    if (y != 0) {
        return count - 2;
    }
    return count - x;
#endif
}

/**
 * Signed saturate a 32 bit value to 8 bits keeping output in 32 bit variable.
 */
__NN_FORCE_INLINE__ int32_t esp_nn_saturate8(int32_t in)
{
#if CONFIG_IDF_TARGET_ARCH_XTENSA
    __asm__ volatile("clamps %0, %0, 7" : "+a"(in));
    return in;
#else
    return max(INT8_MIN, min(in, INT8_MAX));
#endif
}

115:  * We can afford to do this because we are at the very last stage of filter.

120:     int32_t to_add = (1 << (exponent - 1)) - (val < 0);

128:     const int32_t mask = (1 << exponent) - 1;
129:     const int32_t remainder = val & mask;
130:

132:     int32_t threshold = (mask >> 1) + (result < 0);

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <climits>

#include "tensorflow/lite/kernels/internal/common.h"
#include "common_functions.h"

static int tests = 0;
static int failures = 0;

static void check(const char* kind, int32_t a, int32_t b,
                  int32_t shift, int32_t actual, int32_t expected) {
    ++tests;
    if (actual != expected) {
        ++failures;
        if (failures <= 20) {
            std::printf(
                "FAIL %s a=%d b=%d shift=%d actual=%d expected=%d\n",
                kind, a, b, shift, actual, expected);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    const int32_t values[] = {
        INT32_MIN, INT32_MIN + 1, -1073741825, -1073741824,
        -65537, -32769, -257, -129, -65, -33, -17, -9, -5, -3, -2, -1,
        0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 9, 17, 33, 65, 127, 128, 129, 255, 256, 257,
        32767, 32768, 32769, 65535, 65536, 65537,
        1073741823, 1073741824, 1073741825, INT32_MAX - 1, INT32_MAX
    };

    const int value_count = sizeof(values) / sizeof(values[0]);

    // Test ESP-NN high-multiply primitive against the TFLite reference.
    for (int i = 0; i < value_count; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < value_count; ++j) {
            const int32_t a = values[i];
            const int32_t b = values[j];

            const int32_t actual =
                esp_nn_sat_round_doubling_high_mul(a, b);
            const int32_t expected =
                gemmlowp::SaturatingRoundingDoublingHighMul(a, b);

            check("HIGH_MUL", a, b, 0, actual, expected);
        }
    }

    // Test rounded division for exponents 0 through 30.
    for (int i = 0; i < value_count; ++i) {
        for (int exponent = 0; exponent <= 30; ++exponent) {
            const int32_t value = values[i];

            const int32_t actual =
                esp_nn_div_by_power_of_two(value, exponent);
            const int32_t expected =
                gemmlowp::RoundingDivideByPOT(value, exponent);

            check("DIV_POT", value, 0, exponent, actual, expected);
        }
    }

    // Compare the complete ESP-NN requantization helper to TFLite's
    // double-rounding MultiplyByQuantizedMultiplier implementation.
    const int32_t multipliers[] = {
        0, 1, 1073741824, 1073741825, 1610612736, INT32_MAX
    };

    for (int shift = -30; shift <= 7; ++shift) {
        const int left_shift = shift > 0 ? shift : 0;
        const int64_t factor = (int64_t)1 << left_shift;

        for (int i = 0; i < value_count; ++i) {
            const int32_t x = values[i];
            const int64_t shifted = (int64_t)x * factor;

            // Respect the int32 input contract of both implementations.
            if (shifted < INT32_MIN || shifted > INT32_MAX) {
                continue;
            }

            for (unsigned j = 0;
                 j < sizeof(multipliers) / sizeof(multipliers[0]); ++j) {
                const int32_t mult = multipliers[j];

                const int32_t actual =
                    esp_nn_multiply_by_quantized_mult(x, mult, shift);
                const int32_t expected =
                    tflite::MultiplyByQuantizedMultiplier(x, mult, shift);

                check("REQUANTIZE", x, mult, shift, actual, expected);
            }
        }
    }

    std::printf("TESTS=%d FAILURES=%d\n", tests, failures);
    return failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}

@'
from pathlib import Path
import csv
import hashlib
import math
from tensorflow.lite.python import schema_py_generated as schema

model_path = Path(r"MODEL_PATH_PLACEHOLDER")
out_path = Path(r"OUTPUT_PATH_PLACEHOLDER")
blob = model_path.read_bytes()
model = schema.Model.GetRootAsModel(blob, 0)
graph = model.Subgraphs(0)

supported = {
    int(schema.BuiltinOperator.CONV_2D): "CONV_2D",
    int(schema.BuiltinOperator.DEPTHWISE_CONV_2D): "DEPTHWISE_CONV_2D",
}

def tensor_name(t):
    raw = t.Name()
    return raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if raw else ""

def tensor_scales(t):
    q = t.Quantization()
    if q is None:
        return []
    return [float(q.Scale(i)) for i in range(q.ScaleLength())]

def quantize_multiplier(multiplier):
    # TFLite double-rounding QuantizeMultiplier algorithm.
    if multiplier == 0.0:
        return 0, 0
    q, shift = math.frexp(multiplier)
    q_fixed = math.floor(q * (1 << 31) + 0.5)
    if q_fixed == (1 << 31):
        q_fixed //= 2
        shift += 1
    if shift < -31:
        return 0, 0
    return int(q_fixed), int(shift)

rows = []
ops_seen = {"CONV_2D": 0, "DEPTHWISE_CONV_2D": 0}
skipped = 0

for op_index in range(graph.OperatorsLength()):
    op = graph.Operators(op_index)
    opcode = model.OperatorCodes(op.OpcodeIndex())
    builtin = int(opcode.BuiltinCode())

    if builtin not in supported:
        continue

    op_type = supported[builtin]
    inputs = [int(op.Inputs(i)) for i in range(op.InputsLength())]
    outputs = [int(op.Outputs(i)) for i in range(op.OutputsLength())]

    if len(inputs) < 2 or not outputs or min(inputs[:2]) < 0:
        skipped += 1
        continue

    input_t = graph.Tensors(inputs[0])
    filter_t = graph.Tensors(inputs[1])
    output_t = graph.Tensors(outputs[0])

    input_scales = tensor_scales(input_t)
    filter_scales = tensor_scales(filter_t)
    output_scales = tensor_scales(output_t)

    if not input_scales or not filter_scales or not output_scales:
        skipped += 1
        continue
    if input_scales[0] <= 0 or output_scales[0] <= 0:
        skipped += 1
        continue

    input_scale = input_scales[0]
    output_scale = output_scales[0]

    for channel, filter_scale in enumerate(filter_scales):
        if filter_scale <= 0:
            skipped += 1
            continue

        real_multiplier = input_scale * filter_scale / output_scale
        qmult, shift = quantize_multiplier(real_multiplier)

        rows.append({
            "operator_index": op_index,
            "operator_type": op_type,
            "input_tensor": tensor_name(input_t),
            "filter_tensor": tensor_name(filter_t),
            "output_tensor": tensor_name(output_t),
            "channel": channel,
            "input_scale": format(input_scale, ".17g"),
            "filter_scale": format(filter_scale, ".17g"),
            "output_scale": format(output_scale, ".17g"),
            "real_multiplier": format(real_multiplier, ".17g"),
            "quantized_multiplier": qmult,
            "shift": shift,
        })
        ops_seen[op_type] += 1

fields = list(rows[0].keys()) if rows else []
with out_path.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fields)
    if fields:
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)

print("MODEL_SHA256=" + hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest())
print("MODEL_OPERATOR_COUNT=" + str(graph.OperatorsLength()))
