from pathlib import Path
import csv
import hashlib
import math
import re
from tensorflow.lite.python import schema_py_generated as schema

cc_path = Path(r"APP_CC_PLACEHOLDER")
tflite_path = Path(r"TFLITE_MODEL_PLACEHOLDER")
out_path = Path(r"OUTPUT_PATH_PLACEHOLDER")

# Recover the exact model bytes embedded in the firmware C source.
cc_text = cc_path.read_text(encoding="latin-1")
match = re.search(
    r"g_person_detect_model_data\s*\[\s*\]\s*=\s*\{(.*?)\};",
    cc_text,
    re.S,
)
if not match:
    raise RuntimeError("Could not locate g_person_detect_model_data byte array.")

hex_values = re.findall(r"0x([0-9a-fA-F]{1,2})", match.group(1))
if not hex_values:
    raise RuntimeError("Embedded model byte array contained no hexadecimal bytes.")

embedded = bytes(int(v, 16) for v in hex_values)
reference = tflite_path.read_bytes()

embedded_sha = hashlib.sha256(embedded).hexdigest()
reference_sha = hashlib.sha256(reference).hexdigest()

print("EMBEDDED_MODEL_BYTES:", len(embedded))
print("EMBEDDED_MODEL_SHA256:", embedded_sha)
print("REFERENCE_TFLITE_BYTES:", len(reference))
print("REFERENCE_TFLITE_SHA256:", reference_sha)
print("EMBEDDED_EQUALS_REFERENCE_TFLITE:", embedded == reference)

# Parse the embedded bytes, not the separate reference file.
model = schema.Model.GetRootAsModel(embedded, 0)
graph = model.Subgraphs(0)

enum_names = {
    value: name for name, value in vars(schema.BuiltinOperator).items()
    if isinstance(value, int)
}

conv_code = int(schema.BuiltinOperator.CONV_2D)
depthwise_code = int(schema.BuiltinOperator.DEPTHWISE_CONV_2D)

def get_operator_code(opcode):
    # Legacy models may leave BuiltinCode at its default 0 (ADD),
    # while storing the actual opcode in DeprecatedBuiltinCode.
    current = int(opcode.BuiltinCode())
    deprecated = int(opcode.DeprecatedBuiltinCode())
    return deprecated if current == 0 else current

def tensor_name(tensor):
    raw = tensor.Name()
    return raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if raw else ""

def tensor_scales(tensor):
    q = tensor.Quantization()
    if q is None:
        return []
    return [float(q.Scale(i)) for i in range(q.ScaleLength())]

def quantize_multiplier(multiplier):
    # TFLite double-rounding QuantizeMultiplier algorithm.
    if multiplier == 0.0:
        return 0, 0

    q, shift = math.frexp(multiplier)
    q_fixed = math.floor(q * (1 << 31) + 0.5)

    if q_fixed == (1 << 31):
        q_fixed //= 2
        shift += 1

    if shift < -31:
        return 0, 0

    return int(q_fixed), int(shift)

rows = []
conv_ops = 0
depthwise_ops = 0
skipped_ops = 0
seen_ops = set()

for op_index in range(graph.OperatorsLength()):
    op = graph.Operators(op_index)
    opcode = model.OperatorCodes(op.OpcodeIndex())
    code = get_operator_code(opcode)

    if code == conv_code:
        op_type = "CONV_2D"
        conv_ops += 1
    elif code == depthwise_code:
        op_type = "DEPTHWISE_CONV_2D"
        depthwise_ops += 1
    else:
        continue

    seen_ops.add(op_index)
    inputs = [int(op.Inputs(i)) for i in range(op.InputsLength())]
    outputs = [int(op.Outputs(i)) for i in range(op.OutputsLength())]

    if len(inputs) < 2 or not outputs or inputs[0] < 0 or inputs[1] < 0:
        skipped_ops += 1
        continue

    input_t = graph.Tensors(inputs[0])
    filter_t = graph.Tensors(inputs[1])
    output_t = graph.Tensors(outputs[0])

    input_scales = tensor_scales(input_t)
    filter_scales = tensor_scales(filter_t)
    output_scales = tensor_scales(output_t)

    if not input_scales or not filter_scales or not output_scales:
        skipped_ops += 1
        continue
    if input_scales[0] <= 0 or output_scales[0] <= 0:
        skipped_ops += 1
        continue

    in_scale = input_scales[0]
    out_scale = output_scales[0]
    filter_q = filter_t.Quantization()
    qdim = filter_q.QuantizedDimension() if filter_q else -1

    for channel, filter_scale in enumerate(filter_scales):
        if filter_scale <= 0:
            skipped_ops += 1
            continue

        real_multiplier = in_scale * filter_scale / out_scale
        qmult, shift = quantize_multiplier(real_multiplier)

        rows.append({
            "operator_index": op_index,
            "operator_type": op_type,
            "input_tensor": tensor_name(input_t),
            "filter_tensor": tensor_name(filter_t),
            "output_tensor": tensor_name(output_t),
            "channel": channel,
            "filter_quantized_dimension": qdim,
            "input_scale": format(in_scale, ".17g"),
            "filter_scale": format(filter_scale, ".17g"),
            "output_scale": format(out_scale, ".17g"),
            "real_multiplier": format(real_multiplier, ".17g"),
            "quantized_multiplier": qmult,
            "shift": shift,
        })

fields = [
    "operator_index", "operator_type", "input_tensor", "filter_tensor",
    "output_tensor", "channel", "filter_quantized_dimension",
    "input_scale", "filter_scale", "output_scale", "real_multiplier",
    "quantized_multiplier", "shift"
]
with out_path.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fields)
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(rows)

unique_pairs = {
    (row["quantized_multiplier"], row["shift"]) for row in rows
}

print("MODEL_OPERATOR_COUNT:", graph.OperatorsLength())
print("CONV2D_OPERATOR_COUNT:", conv_ops)
print("DEPTHWISE_OPERATOR_COUNT:", depthwise_ops)
print("SKIPPED_CONV_OPERATOR_COUNT:", skipped_ops)
print("CHANNEL_PARAMETER_ROWS:", len(rows))
print("UNIQUE_MULTIPLIER_SHIFT_PAIRS:", len(unique_pairs))
print("CSV_PATH:", out_path)

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <climits>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <set>
#include <utility>

#include "tensorflow/lite/kernels/internal/common.h"
#include "common_functions.h"

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc != 2) {
        std::printf("Usage: test <multiplier_shift.csv>\n");
        return 2;
    }

    std::ifstream file(argv[1]);
    if (!file) {
        std::printf("CSV_OPEN_FAILED\n");
        return 2;
    }

    const int32_t accumulators[] = {
        INT32_MIN, INT32_MIN + 1,
        -1073741824, -65537, -32769, -257, -129, -65,
        -33, -17, -9, -5, -3, -2, -1,
        0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 9, 17, 33, 65, 127, 128, 129,
        255, 256, 257, 32767, 32768, 32769,
        65535, 65536, 65537, 1073741823, 1073741824,
        INT32_MAX - 1, INT32_MAX
    };
    const size_t nx = sizeof(accumulators) / sizeof(accumulators[0]);

    std::string line;
    std::getline(file, line); // CSV header

    long long rows = 0, tested = 0, failures = 0, unsafe_inputs = 0;
    long long unsupported_shift_rows = 0;
    std::set<std::pair<int32_t, int32_t>> pairs;

    while (std::getline(file, line)) {
        if (line.empty()) continue;

        std::stringstream ss(line);
        std::vector<std::string> fields;
        std::string field;
        while (std::getline(ss, field, ',')) fields.push_back(field);

        if (fields.size() < 13) {
            std::printf("CSV_ROW_PARSE_ERROR row=%lld\n", rows + 2);
            return 2;
        }

        int32_t multiplier, shift;
        try {
            multiplier = static_cast<int32_t>(std::stoll(fields[11]));
            shift = static_cast<int32_t>(std::stoll(fields[12]));
        } catch (...) {
            std::printf("CSV_NUMERIC_PARSE_ERROR row=%lld\n", rows + 2);
            return 2;
        }

        ++rows;
        pairs.insert({multiplier, shift});

        // ESP-NN's helper uses a signed 1 << left_shift and
        // a mask formed from 1 << right_shift. Keep this KAT
        // within safely representable shift exponents.
        if (shift < -30 || shift > 30) {
            ++unsupported_shift_rows;
            continue;
        }

        const int left_shift = shift > 0 ? shift : 0;
        const int64_t factor = static_cast<int64_t>(1) << left_shift;

        for (size_t i = 0; i < nx; ++i) {
            const int32_t x = accumulators[i];
            const int64_t shifted = static_cast<int64_t>(x) * factor;

            if (shifted < INT32_MIN || shifted > INT32_MAX) {
                ++unsafe_inputs;
                continue;
            }

            const int32_t actual =
                esp_nn_multiply_by_quantized_mult(x, multiplier, shift);
            const int32_t expected =
                tflite::MultiplyByQuantizedMultiplier(x, multiplier, shift);

            ++tested;
            if (actual != expected) {
                ++failures;
                if (failures <= 20) {
                    std::printf(
                        "FAIL row=%lld x=%d multiplier=%d shift=%d "
                        "ESP_NN=%d TFLITE=%d\n",
                        rows, x, multiplier, shift, actual, expected);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    std::printf("CHANNEL_PARAMETER_ROWS=%lld\n", rows);
    std::printf("UNIQUE_MULTIPLIER_SHIFT_PAIRS=%zu\n", pairs.size());
    std::printf("DIFFERENTIAL_CASES=%lld\n", tested);
    std::printf("FAILURES=%lld\n", failures);
    std::printf("UNSAFE_LEFT_SHIFT_INPUTS_SKIPPED=%lld\n", unsafe_inputs);
    std::printf("UNSUPPORTED_SHIFT_ROWS=%lld\n", unsupported_shift_rows);

    if (unsupported_shift_rows > 0) return 2;
    return failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}

@'
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "tensorflow/lite/kernels/internal/quantization_util.h"

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    if (argc != 2) {
        std::printf("Usage: check <csv_path>\n");
        return 2;
    }

    std::ifstream file(argv[1]);
    if (!file) {
        std::printf("CSV_OPEN_FAILED\n");
        return 2;
    }

    std::string line;
    std::getline(file, line); // Header

    long long rows = 0;
    long long mismatches = 0;

    while (std::getline(file, line)) {
        if (line.empty()) continue;

        std::stringstream ss(line);
        std::vector<std::string> f;
        std::string item;

        while (std::getline(ss, item, ',')) {
            f.push_back(item);
        }

        if (f.size() < 13) {
            std::printf("CSV_PARSE_ERROR at row %lld\n", rows + 2);
            return 2;
        }

        const double real_multiplier = std::stod(f[10]);
        const int32_t python_multiplier =
            static_cast<int32_t>(std::stoll(f[11]));
        const int python_shift = std::stoi(f[12]);

        int32_t cpp_multiplier = 0;
        int cpp_shift = 0;

        tflite::QuantizeMultiplier(
            real_multiplier, &cpp_multiplier, &cpp_shift);

        ++rows;

        if (cpp_multiplier != python_multiplier ||
            cpp_shift != python_shift) {
            ++mismatches;

            if (mismatches <= 20) {
                std::printf(
                    "MISMATCH row=%lld real=%s "
                    "Python=(%d,%d) Cpp=(%d,%d)\n",
                    rows, f[10].c_str(),
                    python_multiplier, python_shift,
                    cpp_multiplier, cpp_shift);
            }
        }
    }

    std::printf("PARAMETER_ROWS=%lld\n", rows);
    std::printf("QUANTIZE_MULTIPLIER_MISMATCHES=%lld\n", mismatches);
    std::printf("RESULT=%s\n", mismatches == 0 ? "PASS" : "FAIL");

    return mismatches == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}

$traceRows = @(
    foreach ($line in Get-Content -LiteralPath $log) {
        $m = [regex]::Match(
            $line.Trim(),
            '^RQ1_TRACE,run=1,op=(\d+),tensor=(\d+),n=(\d+),min=(-?\d+),max=(-?\d+),sum=(-?\d+),fnv1a=([0-9a-fA-F]+)$'
        )
        if ($m.Success) {
            [pscustomobject]@{
                Op       = [int]$m.Groups[1].Value
                Tensor   = [int]$m.Groups[2].Value
                Expected = [int]$m.Groups[3].Value
                Min      = [int]$m.Groups[4].Value
                Max      = [int]$m.Groups[5].Value
                Sum      = [long]$m.Groups[6].Value
                Fnv1a    = $m.Groups[7].Value
                Key      = "$($m.Groups[1].Value):$($m.Groups[2].Value)"
            }
        }
    }
)

$rawRows = @(
    foreach ($line in Get-Content -LiteralPath $log) {
        $m = [regex]::Match(
            $line.Trim(),
            '^RQ1_RAW,run=1,op=(\d+),tensor=(\d+),offset=(\d+),count=(\d+),hex=([0-9a-fA-F]+)$'
        )
        if ($m.Success) {
            [pscustomobject]@{
                Op       = [int]$m.Groups[1].Value
                Tensor   = [int]$m.Groups[2].Value
                Offset   = [int]$m.Groups[3].Value
                Count    = [int]$m.Groups[4].Value
                HexChars = $m.Groups[5].Value.Length
                Key      = "$($m.Groups[1].Value):$($m.Groups[2].Value)"
            }
        }
    }
)

$traceByKey = @{}
foreach ($t in $traceRows) {
    $traceByKey[$t.Key] = $t
}

$rawByKey = @{}
foreach ($r in $rawRows) {
    if (!$rawByKey.ContainsKey($r.Key)) {
        $rawByKey[$r.Key] = @()
    }
    $rawByKey[$r.Key] += $r
}

$audit = @(
    foreach ($t in $traceRows) {
        $chunks = @()
        if ($rawByKey.ContainsKey($t.Key)) {
            $chunks = @($rawByKey[$t.Key] | Sort-Object Offset)
        }

        $cursor = 0
        $captured = 0
        $valid = $true

        foreach ($c in $chunks) {
            if ($c.Offset -ne $cursor) { $valid = $false }
            if ($c.HexChars -ne (2 * $c.Count)) { $valid = $false }

            $cursor = $c.Offset + $c.Count
            $captured += $c.Count
        }

        if ($captured -ne $t.Expected -or $cursor -ne $t.Expected) {
            $valid = $false
        }

        [pscustomobject]@{
            Operator          = $t.Op
            Tensor            = $t.Tensor
            ExpectedElements  = $t.Expected
            CapturedElements  = $captured
            ChunkCount        = $chunks.Count
            FNV1a              = $t.Fnv1a
            CoverageStatus    = if ($valid) { "PASS" } else { "FAIL" }
        }
    }
)

$orphans = @(
    $rawRows | Where-Object { !$traceByKey.ContainsKey($_.Key) }
)

function Read-Capture {
    param([string]$Path)

    $trace = @{}
    $chunks = @{}
    $rawCount = 0

    foreach ($line in [System.IO.File]::ReadLines($Path)) {
        $s = $line.Trim()

        $m = [regex]::Match(
            $s,
            'RQ1_TRACE,run=1,op=(\d+),tensor=(\d+),n=(\d+),min=(-?\d+),max=(-?\d+),sum=(-?\d+),fnv1a=([0-9a-fA-F]+)'
        )

        if ($m.Success) {
            $op = [int]$m.Groups[1].Value
            $tensor = [int]$m.Groups[2].Value
            $key = "{0}:{1}" -f $op, $tensor

            $trace[$key] = [pscustomobject]@{
                Op       = $op
                Tensor   = $tensor
                Expected = [int]$m.Groups[3].Value
                FNV1a    = $m.Groups[7].Value
            }
        }

        $m = [regex]::Match(
            $s,
            'RQ1_RAW,run=1,op=(\d+),tensor=(\d+),offset=(\d+),count=(\d+),hex=([0-9a-fA-F]+)'
        )

        if ($m.Success) {
            $op = [int]$m.Groups[1].Value
            $tensor = [int]$m.Groups[2].Value
            $key = "{0}:{1}" -f $op, $tensor

            if (!$chunks.ContainsKey($key)) {
                $chunks[$key] = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
            }

            $chunks[$key].Add([pscustomobject]@{
                Offset = [int]$m.Groups[3].Value
                Count  = [int]$m.Groups[4].Value
                Hex    = $m.Groups[5].Value.ToLowerInvariant()
            })

            $rawCount++
        }
    }

    $all = @{}
    foreach ($key in $trace.Keys) { $all[$key] = $true }
    foreach ($key in $chunks.Keys) { $all[$key] = $true }

    $tensors = @{}

    foreach ($key in $all.Keys) {
        $t = $null
        if ($trace.ContainsKey($key)) { $t = $trace[$key] }

        $expected = 0
        $fnv = ""
        $op, $tensor = $key.Split(":") | ForEach-Object { [int]$_ }

        if ($null -ne $t) {
            $expected = $t.Expected
            $fnv = $t.FNV1a
        }

        $list = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
        if ($chunks.ContainsKey($key)) {
            foreach ($c in @($chunks[$key] | Sort-Object Offset)) {
                $list.Add($c)
            }
        }

        $cursor = 0
        $captured = 0
        $valid = ($null -ne $t)
        $builder = [System.Text.StringBuilder]::new()

        foreach ($c in $list) {
            if ($c.Offset -ne $cursor) { $valid = $false }
            if ($c.Hex.Length -ne (2 * $c.Count)) { $valid = $false }

            [void]$builder.Append($c.Hex)
            $cursor = $c.Offset + $c.Count
            $captured += $c.Count
        }

        if (($captured -ne $expected) -or ($cursor -ne $expected)) {
            $valid = $false
        }

        $tensors[$key] = [pscustomobject]@{
            Op       = $op
            Tensor   = $tensor
            Expected = $expected
            Captured = $captured
            Chunks   = $list.Count
            FNV1a    = $fnv
            Complete = $valid
            Hex      = $builder.ToString()
        }
    }

    return [pscustomobject]@{
        Path       = $Path
        TraceCount = $trace.Count
        RawCount   = $rawCount
        Tensors    = $tensors
    }
}

"`nReading R1 and R2 logs..."
$a = Read-Capture $r1Path
$b = Read-Capture $r2Path

$allKeys = @{}
foreach ($key in $a.Tensors.Keys) { $allKeys[$key] = $true }
foreach ($key in $b.Tensors.Keys) { $allKeys[$key] = $true }

$rows = @(
    foreach ($key in ($allKeys.Keys | Sort-Object)) {
        $x = $a.Tensors[$key]
        $y = $b.Tensors[$key]

        $equal = $false
        $status = "INCOMPLETE"
        $firstDiff = -1

        if (($null -ne $x) -and ($null -ne $y) -and $x.Complete -and $y.Complete) {
            $equal = [string]::Equals(
                $x.Hex, $y.Hex, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase
            )

            if ($equal) {
                $status = "BITWISE_EQUAL"
            } else {
                $status = "DIFFERENT"
                $limit = [Math]::Min($x.Hex.Length, $y.Hex.Length)

                for ($i = 0; $i -lt $limit; $i += 2) {
                    if ($x.Hex.Substring($i, 2) -cne $y.Hex.Substring($i, 2)) {
                        $firstDiff = [int]($i / 2)
                        break
                    }
                }

                if (($firstDiff -eq -1) -and ($x.Hex.Length -ne $y.Hex.Length)) {
                    $firstDiff = [int]($limit / 2)
                }
            }
        }

        [pscustomobject]@{
            Operator          = if ($x) { $x.Op } else { $y.Op }
            Tensor            = if ($x) { $x.Tensor } else { $y.Tensor }
            Expected_R1       = if ($x) { $x.Expected } else { 0 }
            Expected_R2       = if ($y) { $y.Expected } else { 0 }
            Captured_R1       = if ($x) { $x.Captured } else { 0 }
            Captured_R2       = if ($y) { $y.Captured } else { 0 }
            Chunks_R1         = if ($x) { $x.Chunks } else { 0 }
            Chunks_R2         = if ($y) { $y.Chunks } else { 0 }
            Coverage_R1       = if ($x -and $x.Complete) { "PASS" } else { "FAIL" }
            Coverage_R2       = if ($y -and $y.Complete) { "PASS" } else { "FAIL" }
            FNV1a_R1          = if ($x) { $x.FNV1a } else { "" }
            FNV1a_R2          = if ($y) { $y.FNV1a } else { "" }
            BitwiseEqual      = $equal
            FirstDifferentByte = $firstDiff
            Status            = $status
        }
    }
)

$rows | Export-Csv -LiteralPath $out -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8

"`n=== COMPARISON SUMMARY ==="
"R1_TRACE_RECORDS=$($a.TraceCount)"
"R2_TRACE_RECORDS=$($b.TraceCount)"

    $s = $line.Trim()

    $m = [regex]::Match(
        $s,
        'RQ1_TRACE,run=1,op=(\d+),tensor=(\d+),n=(\d+)'
    )

    if ($m.Success) {
        $key = "$($m.Groups[1].Value):$($m.Groups[2].Value)"
        $traces[$key] = [int]$m.Groups[3].Value
    }

    $m = [regex]::Match(
        $s,
        'RQ1_RAW,run=1,op=(\d+),tensor=(\d+),offset=(\d+),count=(\d+),hex=([0-9a-fA-F]+)'
    )

    if ($m.Success) {
        $key = "$($m.Groups[1].Value):$($m.Groups[2].Value)"

        if (!$chunks.ContainsKey($key)) {
            $chunks[$key] = [System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
        }

        $chunks[$key].Add([pscustomobject]@{
            Offset = [int]$m.Groups[3].Value
            Count  = [int]$m.Groups[4].Value
            Hex    = $m.Groups[5].Value
        })

        $rawCount++
    }

$failed = @()
$captured = 0

    $list = @()
    if ($chunks.ContainsKey($key)) {
        $list = @($chunks[$key] | Sort-Object Offset)
    }

    $cursor = 0
    $count = 0
    $ok = $true

    foreach ($c in $list) {
        if ($c.Offset -ne $cursor) { $ok = $false }
        if ($c.Hex.Length -ne (2 * $c.Count)) { $ok = $false }

        $cursor = $c.Offset + $c.Count
        $count += $c.Count
    }

    if ($count -ne $traces[$key] -or $cursor -ne $traces[$key]) {
        $ok = $false
    }

    $captured += $count

    if ($ok) {
        $passed++
    } else {
        $failed += "$key expected=$($traces[$key]) captured=$count"
    }
}

function Read-RQ1Capture {
    param([string]$Path)

    $trace = @{}
    $raw = @{}
    $traceCount = 0
    $rawCount = 0

    foreach ($line in [System.IO.File]::ReadLines($Path)) {
        $m = [regex]::Match(
            $line,
            'RQ1_TRACE,run=(\d+),op=(\d+),tensor=(\d+),n=(\d+),min=(-?\d+),max=(-?\d+),sum=(-?\d+),fnv1a=([0-9a-fA-F]+)'
        )

        if ($m.Success -and $m.Groups[1].Value -eq "1") {
            $key = "$($m.Groups[2].Value)|$($m.Groups[3].Value)"
            $trace[$key] = [pscustomobject]@{
                Op    = [int]$m.Groups[2].Value
                Tensor = [int]$m.Groups[3].Value
                N     = [int]$m.Groups[4].Value
                FNV   = $m.Groups[8].Value.ToLowerInvariant()
            }
            $traceCount++
            continue
        }

        $m = [regex]::Match(
            $line,
            'RQ1_RAW,run=(\d+),op=(\d+),tensor=(\d+),offset=(\d+),count=(\d+),hex=([0-9a-fA-F]+)'
        )

        if ($m.Success -and $m.Groups[1].Value -eq "1") {
            $key = "$($m.Groups[2].Value)|$($m.Groups[3].Value)"

            if (-not $raw.ContainsKey($key)) {
                $raw[$key] = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.List[object]'
            }

            $raw[$key].Add([pscustomobject]@{
                Offset = [int]$m.Groups[4].Value
                Count  = [int]$m.Groups[5].Value
                Hex    = $m.Groups[6].Value.ToLowerInvariant()
            })

            $rawCount++
        }
    }

    return [pscustomobject]@{
        Trace = $trace
        Raw = $raw
        TraceCount = $traceCount
        RawCount = $rawCount
    }
}

function Get-TensorBytes {
    param($Capture, [string]$Key)

    if (-not $Capture.Trace.ContainsKey($Key)) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Complete = $false; Hex = ""; N = 0 }
    }

    if (-not $Capture.Raw.ContainsKey($Key)) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{
            Complete = $false
            Hex = ""
            N = $Capture.Trace[$Key].N
        }
    }

    $chunks = @($Capture.Raw[$Key] | Sort-Object Offset)
    $cursor = 0
    $hex = ""

    foreach ($chunk in $chunks) {
        if ($chunk.Offset -ne $cursor) {
            return [pscustomobject]@{
                Complete = $false
                Hex = $hex
                N = $Capture.Trace[$Key].N
            }
        }

        $byteCount = [int]($chunk.Hex.Length / 2)

        if (($chunk.Hex.Length % 2) -ne 0 -or
            $byteCount -ne $chunk.Count) {
            return [pscustomobject]@{
                Complete = $false
                Hex = $hex
                N = $Capture.Trace[$Key].N
            }
        }

        $hex += $chunk.Hex
        $cursor += $byteCount
    }

    return [pscustomobject]@{
        Complete = ($cursor -eq $Capture.Trace[$Key].N)
        Hex = $hex
        N = $Capture.Trace[$Key].N
    }
}

$r1 = Read-RQ1Capture $r1Path
$r2 = Read-RQ1Capture $r2Path

Write-Host "`nR1_TRACE_RECORDS=$($r1.TraceCount)"
Write-Host "R2_TRACE_RECORDS=$($r2.TraceCount)"
Write-Host "R1_RAW_RECORDS=$($r1.RawCount)"
Write-Host "R2_RAW_RECORDS=$($r2.RawCount)"

$keys = @($r1.Trace.Keys + $r2.Trace.Keys | Sort-Object -Unique)
$equal = 0
$different = 0
$incomplete = 0
$rows = @()

foreach ($key in $keys) {
    $a = Get-TensorBytes $r1 $key
    $b = Get-TensorBytes $r2 $key

    $hasR1 = $r1.Trace.ContainsKey($key)
    $hasR2 = $r2.Trace.ContainsKey($key)

    if (-not $hasR1 -or -not $hasR2 -or
        -not $a.Complete -or -not $b.Complete) {
        $status = "INCOMPLETE"
        $incomplete++
    }
    elseif ($a.Hex -ceq $b.Hex) {
        $status = "BITWISE_EQUAL"
        $equal++
    }
    else {
        $status = "DIFFERENT"
        $different++
    }

    $rows += [pscustomobject]@{
        Op = ($key -split '\|')[0]
        Tensor = ($key -split '\|')[1]
        R1_Elements = $a.N
        R2_Elements = $b.N
        R1_FNV = if ($hasR1) { $r1.Trace[$key].FNV } else { "" }
        R2_FNV = if ($hasR2) { $r2.Trace[$key].FNV } else { "" }
        Status = $status
    }
}

$rows | Export-Csv -Path $csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8

Write-Host "`nBITWISE_EQUAL_TENSORS=$equal"
Write-Host "DIFFERENT_TENSORS=$different"
Write-Host "INCOMPLETE_TENSORS=$incomplete"
Write-Host "CSV_REPORT=$csv"

if ($different -eq 0 -and $incomplete -eq 0 -and
    $r1.TraceCount -eq $r2.TraceCount) {
    Write-Host "IMAGE11_FULL_TENSOR_COMPARISON=PASS"
}
else {
    Write-Host "IMAGE11_FULL_TENSOR_COMPARISON=CHECK_REQUIRED"
}

function Read-Capture([string]$Path) {
    $trace = @{}
    $raw = @{}
    $traceCount = 0
    $rawCount = 0

    foreach ($line in [System.IO.File]::ReadLines($Path)) {
        $m = [regex]::Match(
            $line,
            'RQ1_TRACE,run=(\d+),op=(\d+),tensor=(\d+),n=(\d+),min=(-?\d+),max=(-?\d+),sum=(-?\d+),fnv1a=([0-9a-fA-F]+)'
        )

        if ($m.Success -and $m.Groups[1].Value -eq "1") {
            $key = "$($m.Groups[2].Value)|$($m.Groups[3].Value)"
            $trace[$key] = [pscustomobject]@{
                N = [int]$m.Groups[4].Value
                FNV = $m.Groups[8].Value.ToLowerInvariant()
            }
            $traceCount++
            continue
        }

        $m = [regex]::Match(
            $line,
            'RQ1_RAW,run=(\d+),op=(\d+),tensor=(\d+),offset=(\d+),count=(\d+),hex=([0-9a-fA-F]+)'
        )

        if ($m.Success -and $m.Groups[1].Value -eq "1") {
            $key = "$($m.Groups[2].Value)|$($m.Groups[3].Value)"
            if (-not $raw.ContainsKey($key)) {
                $raw[$key] = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.List[object]'
            }
            $raw[$key].Add([pscustomobject]@{
                Offset = [int]$m.Groups[4].Value
                Count = [int]$m.Groups[5].Value
                Hex = $m.Groups[6].Value.ToLowerInvariant()
            })
            $rawCount++
        }
    }

    [pscustomobject]@{
        Trace = $trace
        Raw = $raw
        TraceCount = $traceCount
        RawCount = $rawCount
    }
}

function Get-TensorHex($capture, [string]$key) {
    if (-not $capture.Trace.ContainsKey($key) -or
        -not $capture.Raw.ContainsKey($key)) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Complete = $false; Hex = "" }
    }

    $chunks = @($capture.Raw[$key] | Sort-Object Offset)
    $cursor = 0
    $hex = ""

    foreach ($chunk in $chunks) {
        if ($chunk.Offset -ne $cursor -or
            ($chunk.Hex.Length % 2) -ne 0 -or
            ($chunk.Hex.Length / 2) -ne $chunk.Count) {
            return [pscustomobject]@{ Complete = $false; Hex = $hex }
        }

        $hex += $chunk.Hex
        $cursor += $chunk.Count
    }

    [pscustomobject]@{
        Complete = ($cursor -eq $capture.Trace[$key].N)
        Hex = $hex
    }
}

        R2_FNV = if ($r2.Trace.ContainsKey($key)) { $r2.Trace[$key].FNV } else { "" }
        Status = $status
    }
}

function Read-Capture([string]$Path) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $Path)) { throw "Log not found: $Path" }

    $trace = @{}
    $raw = @{}
    $traceCount = 0
    $rawCount = 0

    foreach ($line in [System.IO.File]::ReadLines($Path)) {
        $m = [regex]::Match(
            $line,
            'RQ1_TRACE,run=(\d+),op=(\d+),tensor=(\d+),n=(\d+),min=(-?\d+),max=(-?\d+),sum=(-?\d+),fnv1a=([0-9a-fA-F]+)'
        )

        if ($m.Success -and $m.Groups[1].Value -eq "1") {
            $key = "$($m.Groups[2].Value)|$($m.Groups[3].Value)"
            $trace[$key] = [pscustomobject]@{
                N = [int]$m.Groups[4].Value
                FNV = $m.Groups[8].Value.ToLowerInvariant()
            }
            $traceCount++
            continue
        }

        $m = [regex]::Match(
            $line,
            'RQ1_RAW,run=(\d+),op=(\d+),tensor=(\d+),offset=(\d+),count=(\d+),hex=([0-9a-fA-F]+)'
        )

        if ($m.Success -and $m.Groups[1].Value -eq "1") {
            $key = "$($m.Groups[2].Value)|$($m.Groups[3].Value)"
            if (-not $raw.ContainsKey($key)) {
                $raw[$key] = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.List[object]'
            }
            $raw[$key].Add([pscustomobject]@{
                Offset = [int]$m.Groups[4].Value
                Count = [int]$m.Groups[5].Value
                Hex = $m.Groups[6].Value.ToLowerInvariant()
            })
            $rawCount++
        }
    }

    [pscustomobject]@{
        Trace = $trace
        Raw = $raw
        TraceCount = $traceCount
        RawCount = $rawCount
        Path = $Path
    }
}

function Get-TensorHex($capture, [string]$key) {
    if (-not $capture.Trace.ContainsKey($key) -or
        -not $capture.Raw.ContainsKey($key)) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Complete = $false; Hex = "" }
    }

    $chunks = @($capture.Raw[$key] | Sort-Object Offset)
    $cursor = 0
    $hex = ""

    foreach ($chunk in $chunks) {
        $byteCount = [int]($chunk.Hex.Length / 2)

        if (($chunk.Hex.Length % 2) -ne 0 -or
            $chunk.Offset -ne $cursor -or
            $byteCount -ne $chunk.Count) {
            return [pscustomobject]@{ Complete = $false; Hex = $hex }
        }

        $hex += $chunk.Hex
        $cursor += $byteCount
    }

    [pscustomobject]@{
        Complete = ($cursor -eq $capture.Trace[$key].N)
        Hex = $hex
    }
}

$r1 = Read-Capture $r1Path
$r2 = Read-Capture $r2Path

foreach ($capture in @($r1, $r2)) {
    $file = Get-Item $capture.Path
    Write-Host "`nFILE=$($file.Name)"
    Write-Host "BYTES=$($file.Length)"
    Write-Host "SHA256=$((Get-FileHash $capture.Path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash)"
}

Write-Host "`nR1_TRACE_RECORDS=$($r1.TraceCount)"
Write-Host "R2_TRACE_RECORDS=$($r2.TraceCount)"
Write-Host "R1_RAW_RECORDS=$($r1.RawCount)"
Write-Host "R2_RAW_RECORDS=$($r2.RawCount)"

$keys = @($r1.Trace.Keys + $r2.Trace.Keys | Sort-Object -Unique)
$equal = 0
$different = 0
$incomplete = 0

$rows = foreach ($key in $keys) {
    $a = Get-TensorHex $r1 $key
    $b = Get-TensorHex $r2 $key

    if (-not $r1.Trace.ContainsKey($key) -or
        -not $r2.Trace.ContainsKey($key) -or
        -not $a.Complete -or -not $b.Complete) {
        $status = "INCOMPLETE"
        $incomplete++
    }
    elseif ($a.Hex -ceq $b.Hex) {
        $status = "BITWISE_EQUAL"
        $equal++
    }
    else {
        $status = "DIFFERENT"
        $different++
    }

    [pscustomobject]@{
        Op = ($key -split '\|')[0]
        Tensor = ($key -split '\|')[1]
        R1_FNV = if ($r1.Trace.ContainsKey($key)) { $r1.Trace[$key].FNV } else { "" }
        R2_FNV = if ($r2.Trace.ContainsKey($key)) { $r2.Trace[$key].FNV } else { "" }
        Status = $status
    }
}

PS C:\Users\nk947\Downloads\robot-runtime-research\tflite-micro> $pd = "C:\Users\nk947\Downloads\robot-runtime-research\esp-tflite-micro\examples\person_detection"

$r1Path = Join-Path $pd "log.person_detection.20261025215147.txt"
$r2Path = Join-Path $pd "log.person_detection.20261025215438.txt"

function Read-Capture([string]$Path) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $Path)) { throw "Log not found: $Path" }

    $trace = @{}
    $raw = @{}
    $traceCount = 0
    $rawCount = 0

    foreach ($line in [System.IO.File]::ReadLines($Path)) {
        $m = [regex]::Match(
            $line,
            'RQ1_TRACE,run=(\d+),op=(\d+),tensor=(\d+),n=(\d+),min=(-?\d+),max=(-?\d+),sum=(-?\d+),fnv1a=([0-9a-fA-F]+)'
        )

        if ($m.Success -and $m.Groups[1].Value -eq "1") {
            $key = "$($m.Groups[2].Value)|$($m.Groups[3].Value)"
            $trace[$key] = [pscustomobject]@{
                N   = [int]$m.Groups[4].Value
                FNV = $m.Groups[8].Value.ToLowerInvariant()
            }
            $traceCount++
            continue
        }

        $m = [regex]::Match(
            $line,
            'RQ1_RAW,run=(\d+),op=(\d+),tensor=(\d+),offset=(\d+),count=(\d+),hex=([0-9a-fA-F]+)'
        )

        if ($m.Success -and $m.Groups[1].Value -eq "1") {
            $key = "$($m.Groups[2].Value)|$($m.Groups[3].Value)"

            if (-not $raw.ContainsKey($key)) {
                $raw[$key] = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.List[object]'
            }

            $raw[$key].Add([pscustomobject]@{
                Offset = [int]$m.Groups[4].Value
                Count  = [int]$m.Groups[5].Value
                Hex    = $m.Groups[6].Value.ToLowerInvariant()
            })
            $rawCount++
        }
    }

    [pscustomobject]@{
        Trace = $trace
        Raw = $raw
        TraceCount = $traceCount
        RawCount = $rawCount
        Path = $Path
    }
}

function Get-TensorHex($capture, [string]$key) {
    if (-not $capture.Trace.ContainsKey($key) -or
        -not $capture.Raw.ContainsKey($key)) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Complete = $false; Hex = "" }
    }

    $chunks = @($capture.Raw[$key] | Sort-Object Offset)
    $cursor = 0
    $hex = ""

    foreach ($chunk in $chunks) {
        $byteCount = [int]($chunk.Hex.Length / 2)

        if (($chunk.Hex.Length % 2) -ne 0 -or
            $chunk.Offset -ne $cursor -or
            $byteCount -ne $chunk.Count) {
            return [pscustomobject]@{ Complete = $false; Hex = $hex }
        }

        $hex += $chunk.Hex
        $cursor += $byteCount
    }

    [pscustomobject]@{
        Complete = ($cursor -eq $capture.Trace[$key].N)
        Hex = $hex
    }
}

$r1 = Read-Capture $r1Path
$r2 = Read-Capture $r2Path

foreach ($capture in @($r1, $r2)) {
    $file = Get-Item $capture.Path
    Write-Host "`nFILE=$($file.Name)"
    Write-Host "BYTES=$($file.Length)"
    Write-Host "SHA256=$((Get-FileHash $capture.Path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash)"
}

Write-Host "`nR1_TRACE_RECORDS=$($r1.TraceCount)"
Write-Host "R2_TRACE_RECORDS=$($r2.TraceCount)"
Write-Host "R1_RAW_RECORDS=$($r1.RawCount)"
Write-Host "R2_RAW_RECORDS=$($r2.RawCount)"

$keys = @($r1.Trace.Keys + $r2.Trace.Keys | Sort-Object -Unique)
$equal = 0
$different = 0
$incomplete = 0

$rows = foreach ($key in $keys) {
    $a = Get-TensorHex $r1 $key
    $b = Get-TensorHex $r2 $key

    if (-not $r1.Trace.ContainsKey($key) -or
        -not $r2.Trace.ContainsKey($key) -or
        -not $a.Complete -or -not $b.Complete) {
        $status = "INCOMPLETE"
        $incomplete++
    }
    elseif ($a.Hex -ceq $b.Hex) {
        $status = "BITWISE_EQUAL"
        $equal++
    }
    else {
        $status = "DIFFERENT"
        $different++
    }

    [pscustomobject]@{
        Op = ($key -split '\|')[0]
        Tensor = ($key -split '\|')[1]
        R1_FNV = if ($r1.Trace.ContainsKey($key)) { $r1.Trace[$key].FNV } else { "" }
        R2_FNV = if ($r2.Trace.ContainsKey($key)) { $r2.Trace[$key].FNV } else { "" }
        Status = $status
    }
}

$csv = Join-Path $pd "w1_r1_vs_r2_image3_raw_tensor_compare_2026-10-25.csv"
$rows | Export-Csv -Path $csv -NoTypeInformation -Encoding UTF8

Write-Host "`nBITWISE_EQUAL_TENSORS=$equal"
Write-Host "DIFFERENT_TENSORS=$different"
Write-Host "INCOMPLETE_TENSORS=$incomplete"
Write-Host "CSV_REPORT=$csv"

if ($equal -eq 31 -and $different -eq 0 -and
    $incomplete -eq 0 -and $r1.TraceCount -eq $r2.TraceCount) {
    Write-Host "IMAGE3_FULL_TENSOR_COMPARISON=PASS"
}
else {
    Write-Host "IMAGE3_FULL_TENSOR_COMPARISON=CHECK_REQUIRED"
}

function Read-Capture([string]$Path) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $Path)) { throw "Log not found: $Path" }

    $trace = @{}
    $raw = @{}
    $traceCount = 0
    $rawCount = 0

    foreach ($line in [System.IO.File]::ReadLines($Path)) {
        $m = [regex]::Match($line, 'RQ1_TRACE,run=(\d+),op=(\d+),tensor=(\d+),n=(\d+),min=(-?\d+),max=(-?\d+),sum=(-?\d+),fnv1a=([0-9a-fA-F]+)')

        if ($m.Success -and $m.Groups[1].Value -eq "1") {
            $key = "$($m.Groups[2].Value)|$($m.Groups[3].Value)"
            $trace[$key] = [pscustomobject]@{
                N = [int]$m.Groups[4].Value
                FNV = $m.Groups[8].Value.ToLowerInvariant()
            }
            $traceCount++
            continue
        }

        $m = [regex]::Match($line, 'RQ1_RAW,run=(\d+),op=(\d+),tensor=(\d+),offset=(\d+),count=(\d+),hex=([0-9a-fA-F]+)')

        if ($m.Success -and $m.Groups[1].Value -eq "1") {
            $key = "$($m.Groups[2].Value)|$($m.Groups[3].Value)"
            if (-not $raw.ContainsKey($key)) {
                $raw[$key] = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.List[object]'
            }
            $raw[$key].Add([pscustomobject]@{
                Offset = [int]$m.Groups[4].Value
                Count = [int]$m.Groups[5].Value
                Hex = $m.Groups[6].Value.ToLowerInvariant()
            })
            $rawCount++
        }
    }

    [pscustomobject]@{
        Trace = $trace
        Raw = $raw
        TraceCount = $traceCount
        RawCount = $rawCount
        Path = $Path
    }
}

function Get-TensorHex($capture, [string]$key) {
    if (-not $capture.Trace.ContainsKey($key) -or -not $capture.Raw.ContainsKey($key)) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Complete = $false; Hex = "" }
    }

    $chunks = @($capture.Raw[$key] | Sort-Object Offset)
    $cursor = 0
    $hex = ""

    foreach ($chunk in $chunks) {
        $byteCount = [int]($chunk.Hex.Length / 2)
        if (($chunk.Hex.Length % 2) -ne 0 -or $chunk.Offset -ne $cursor -or $byteCount -ne $chunk.Count) {
            return [pscustomobject]@{ Complete = $false; Hex = $hex }
        }
        $hex += $chunk.Hex
        $cursor += $byteCount
    }

    [pscustomobject]@{
        Complete = ($cursor -eq $capture.Trace[$key].N)
        Hex = $hex
    }
}

        R2_FNV = if ($r2.Trace.ContainsKey($key)) { $r2.Trace[$key].FNV } else { "" }
        Status = $status
    }
}

    $trace = @{}
    $raw = @{}
    $traceCount = 0
    $rawCount = 0

    foreach ($line in [System.IO.File]::ReadLines($Path)) {
        $m = [regex]::Match(
            $line,
            'RQ1_TRACE,run=(\d+),op=(\d+),tensor=(\d+),n=(\d+),min=(-?\d+),max=(-?\d+),sum=(-?\d+),fnv1a=([0-9a-fA-F]+)'

        }

        $m = [regex]::Match(
            $line,
            'RQ1_RAW,run=(\d+),op=(\d+),tensor=(\d+),offset=(\d+),count=(\d+),hex=([0-9a-fA-F]+)'

        if ($m.Success -and $m.Groups[1].Value -eq "1") {

            $raw[$key].Add([pscustomobject]@{
                Offset = [int]$m.Groups[4].Value
                Count = [int]$m.Groups[5].Value

    }

        Trace = $trace
        Raw = $raw
        TraceCount = $traceCount
        RawCount = $rawCount
        Path = $Path
    }

$r2Path = Join-Path $pd "log.person_detection.20261025222956.txt"

function Read-Capture([string]$Path) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $Path)) {
        throw "Log not found: $Path"
    }

    $trace = @{}
    $raw = @{}
    $traceCount = 0
    $rawCount = 0

    foreach ($line in [System.IO.File]::ReadLines($Path)) {
        $m = [regex]::Match(
            $line,
            'RQ1_TRACE,run=(\d+),op=(\d+),tensor=(\d+),n=(\d+),min=(-?\d+),max=(-?\d+),sum=(-?\d+),fnv1a=([0-9a-fA-F]+)'
        )

        if ($m.Success -and $m.Groups[1].Value -eq "1") {
            $key = "$($m.Groups[2].Value)|$($m.Groups[3].Value)"
            $trace[$key] = [pscustomobject]@{
                N = [int]$m.Groups[4].Value
                FNV = $m.Groups[8].Value.ToLowerInvariant()
            }
            $traceCount++
            continue
        }

        $m = [regex]::Match(
            $line,
            'RQ1_RAW,run=(\d+),op=(\d+),tensor=(\d+),offset=(\d+),count=(\d+),hex=([0-9a-fA-F]+)'
        )

        if ($m.Success -and $m.Groups[1].Value -eq "1") {
            $key = "$($m.Groups[2].Value)|$($m.Groups[3].Value)"

            if (-not $raw.ContainsKey($key)) {
                $raw[$key] = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.List[object]'
            }

            $raw[$key].Add([pscustomobject]@{
                Offset = [int]$m.Groups[4].Value
                Count = [int]$m.Groups[5].Value
                Hex = $m.Groups[6].Value.ToLowerInvariant()
            })
            $rawCount++
        }
    }

    [pscustomobject]@{
        Trace = $trace
        Raw = $raw
        TraceCount = $traceCount
        RawCount = $rawCount
        Path = $Path
    }
}

function Get-TensorHex($capture, [string]$key) {
    if (-not $capture.Trace.ContainsKey($key) -or
        -not $capture.Raw.ContainsKey($key)) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Complete = $false; Hex = "" }
    }

    $chunks = @($capture.Raw[$key] | Sort-Object Offset)
    $cursor = 0
    $hex = ""

    foreach ($chunk in $chunks) {
        $byteCount = [int]($chunk.Hex.Length / 2)

        if (($chunk.Hex.Length % 2) -ne 0 -or
            $chunk.Offset -ne $cursor -or
            $byteCount -ne $chunk.Count) {
            return [pscustomobject]@{ Complete = $false; Hex = $hex }
        }

        $hex += $chunk.Hex
        $cursor += $byteCount
    }

    [pscustomobject]@{
        Complete = ($cursor -eq $capture.Trace[$key].N)
        Hex = $hex
    }
}

$r1 = Read-Capture $r1Path
$r2 = Read-Capture $r2Path

foreach ($capture in @($r1, $r2)) {
    $file = Get-Item $capture.Path
    Write-Host "`nFILE=$($file.Name)"
    Write-Host "BYTES=$($file.Length)"
    Write-Host "SHA256=$((Get-FileHash $capture.Path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash)"
}

Write-Host "`nR1_TRACE_RECORDS=$($r1.TraceCount)"

Write-Host "R1_RAW_RECORDS=$($r1.RawCount)"
Write-Host "R2_RAW_RECORDS=$($r2.RawCount)"

$keys = @($r1.Trace.Keys + $r2.Trace.Keys | Sort-Object -Unique)
$equal = 0
$different = 0
$incomplete = 0

$rows = foreach ($key in $keys) {
    $a = Get-TensorHex $r1 $key
    $b = Get-TensorHex $r2 $key

    if (-not $r1.Trace.ContainsKey($key) -or
        -not $r2.Trace.ContainsKey($key) -or
        -not $a.Complete -or -not $b.Complete) {
        $status = "INCOMPLETE"
        $incomplete++
    }
    elseif ($a.Hex -ceq $b.Hex) {
        $status = "BITWISE_EQUAL"
        $equal++
    }
    else {
        $status = "DIFFERENT"
        $different++
    }

    [pscustomobject]@{
        Op = ($key -split '\|')[0]
        Tensor = ($key -split '\|')[1]
        R1_FNV = if ($r1.Trace.ContainsKey($key)) { $r1.Trace[$key].FNV } else { "" }
        R2_FNV = if ($r2.Trace.ContainsKey($key)) { $r2.Trace[$key].FNV } else { "" }
        Status = $status
    }
}

function Read-Capture([string]$Path) {
    if (-not (Test-Path $Path)) { throw "Log not found: $Path" }

    $trace = @{}
    $raw = @{}
    $traceCount = 0
    $rawCount = 0

    foreach ($line in [System.IO.File]::ReadLines($Path)) {
        $m = [regex]::Match($line, 'RQ1_TRACE,run=(\d+),op=(\d+),tensor=(\d+),n=(\d+),min=(-?\d+),max=(-?\d+),sum=(-?\d+),fnv1a=([0-9a-fA-F]+)')

        if ($m.Success -and $m.Groups[1].Value -eq "1") {
            $key = "$($m.Groups[2].Value)|$($m.Groups[3].Value)"
            $trace[$key] = [pscustomobject]@{
                N = [int]$m.Groups[4].Value
                FNV = $m.Groups[8].Value.ToLowerInvariant()
            }
            $traceCount++
            continue
        }

        $m = [regex]::Match($line, 'RQ1_RAW,run=(\d+),op=(\d+),tensor=(\d+),offset=(\d+),count=(\d+),hex=([0-9a-fA-F]+)')

        if ($m.Success -and $m.Groups[1].Value -eq "1") {
            $key = "$($m.Groups[2].Value)|$($m.Groups[3].Value)"
            if (-not $raw.ContainsKey($key)) {
                $raw[$key] = New-Object 'System.Collections.Generic.List[object]'
            }
            $raw[$key].Add([pscustomobject]@{
                Offset = [int]$m.Groups[4].Value
                Count = [int]$m.Groups[5].Value
                Hex = $m.Groups[6].Value.ToLowerInvariant()
            })
            $rawCount++
        }
    }

    [pscustomobject]@{
        Trace = $trace
        Raw = $raw
        TraceCount = $traceCount
        RawCount = $rawCount
        Path = $Path
    }
}

function Get-TensorHex($capture, [string]$key) {
    if (-not $capture.Trace.ContainsKey($key) -or -not $capture.Raw.ContainsKey($key)) {
        return [pscustomobject]@{ Complete = $false; Hex = "" }
    }

    $chunks = @($capture.Raw[$key] | Sort-Object Offset)
    $cursor = 0
    $hex = ""

    foreach ($chunk in $chunks) {
        $byteCount = [int]($chunk.Hex.Length / 2)
        if (($chunk.Hex.Length % 2) -ne 0 -or $chunk.Offset -ne $cursor -or $byteCount -ne $chunk.Count) {
            return [pscustomobject]@{ Complete = $false; Hex = $hex }
        }
        $hex += $chunk.Hex
        $cursor += $byteCount
    }

    [pscustomobject]@{
        Complete = ($cursor -eq $capture.Trace[$key].N)
        Hex = $hex
    }
}

$summary = foreach ($check in $checks) {
    $path = Join-Path $pd $check.File

    if (-not (Test-Path $path)) {
        [pscustomobject]@{
            Image = $check.Image
            ComparisonFile = $check.File
            CSVRows = 0
            EqualTensors = 0
            DifferentTensors = 0
            IncompleteTensors = 0
            CSV_SHA256 = ""
            Status = "MISSING_CSV"
        }
        continue
    }

    $rows = @(Import-Csv $path)
    $equal = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq "BITWISE_EQUAL" }).Count
    $different = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq "DIFFERENT" }).Count
    $incomplete = @($rows | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq "INCOMPLETE" }).Count
    $hash = (Get-FileHash $path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash

    $status = if (
        $rows.Count -eq 31 -and
        $equal -eq 31 -and
        $different -eq 0 -and
        $incomplete -eq 0
    ) {
        "PASS"
    }
    else {
        "CHECK_REQUIRED"
    }

    [pscustomobject]@{
        Image = $check.Image
        ComparisonFile = $check.File
        CSVRows = $rows.Count
        EqualTensors = $equal
        DifferentTensors = $different
        IncompleteTensors = $incomplete
        CSV_SHA256 = $hash
        Status = $status
    }
}

$totalDifferent = ($summary | Measure-Object -Property DifferentTensors -Sum).Sum
$totalIncomplete = ($summary | Measure-Object -Property IncompleteTensors -Sum).Sum

function Get-ArtifactRecord {
    param(
        [string]$Type,
        [string]$Image,
        [string]$File
    )

    $path = Join-Path $pd $File

    if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path) {
        $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $path
        $hash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash

        [pscustomobject]@{
            ArtifactType = $Type
            Image = $Image
            FileName = $item.Name
            Bytes = $item.Length
            SHA256 = $hash
            Status = "PRESENT"
        }
    }
    else {
        [pscustomobject]@{
            ArtifactType = $Type
            Image = $Image
            FileName = $File
            Bytes = ""
            SHA256 = ""
            Status = "MISSING"
        }
    }
}

foreach ($img in $images) {
    $manifest += Get-ArtifactRecord "R1_RAW_LOG" "$($img.Image)" $img.R1
    $manifest += Get-ArtifactRecord "R2_RAW_LOG" "$($img.Image)" $img.R2
    $manifest += Get-ArtifactRecord "TENSOR_COMPARISON_CSV" "$($img.Image)" $img.CSV
}

}
else {
    Write-Host "EVIDENCE_MANIFEST=CHECK_REQUIRED"
    $manifest | Where-Object { $_.Status -eq "MISSING" } | Format-Table ArtifactType, Image, FileName
}

    }
}

========== REGISTERED BENCHMARK IMPLEMENTATION ==========
    long long x = *(const long long *)a;
    long long y = *(const long long *)b;
    return (x > y) - (x < y);
}

static int benchmark_cli_handler(int argc, char *argv[])
{
    if (argc != 2) {
        printf("Usage: benchmark <measured_runs 1..10000>\n");
        return 1;
    }
    char *end = NULL;
    long requested = strtol(argv[1], &end, 10);
    if (end == argv[1] || *end != '\0' || requested < 1 || requested > 10000) {
        printf("ERROR: measured_runs must be between 1 and 10000\n");
        return 1;
    }
    const int runs = (int)requested;
    const int warmup_runs = 10;
    benchmark_sample_t *samples = (benchmark_sample_t *)calloc((size_t)runs, sizeof(*samples));
    long long *sorted = (long long *)calloc((size_t)runs, sizeof(*sorted));
    if (samples == NULL || sorted == NULL) {
        free(samples); free(sorted);
        printf("ERROR: benchmark sample allocation failed\n");
        return 1;
    }
    printf("BENCH_START,runs=%d,warmup=%d,images=%d,timing=interpreter_Invoke_only\n",
           runs, warmup_runs, BENCHMARK_IMAGE_COUNT);
    g_benchmark_mode = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < warmup_runs; ++i) {
        run_inference((void *)image_database[i % BENCHMARK_IMAGE_COUNT]);
        vTaskDelay(1);
    }
    int failures = 0;
    int successful_runs = 0;
    long long sum = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < runs; ++i) {
        int image = i % BENCHMARK_IMAGE_COUNT;
        run_inference((void *)image_database[image]);
        vTaskDelay(1);

        samples[i].us = g_last_invoke_us;
        samples[i].cycles = g_last_invoke_cycles;
        samples[i].image = image;
        samples[i].ok = g_last_invoke_ok;
        samples[i].raw_person =
            samples[i].ok ? g_last_raw_person : 0;
        samples[i].raw_no_person =
            samples[i].ok ? g_last_raw_no_person : 0;

        if (!samples[i].ok) {
            failures++;
            continue;
        }

        sorted[successful_runs++] = samples[i].us;
        sum += samples[i].us;
    }

    g_benchmark_mode = 0;

    long long mean_us = -1;
    long long median = -1;
    long long p95_us = -1;
    long long min_us = -1;
    long long max_us = -1;

    if (successful_runs > 0) {
        qsort(sorted, (size_t)successful_runs,
              sizeof(*sorted), compare_long_long);

        mean_us = sum / successful_runs;
        min_us = sorted[0];
        max_us = sorted[successful_runs - 1];

        if (successful_runs % 2) {
            median = sorted[successful_runs / 2];
        } else {
            median =
                sorted[successful_runs / 2 - 1] / 2 +
                sorted[successful_runs / 2] / 2 +
                ((sorted[successful_runs / 2 - 1] % 2 +
                  sorted[successful_runs / 2] % 2) / 2);
        }

        int p95_index =
            (int)(((long long)95 * successful_runs + 99) / 100) - 1;

        if (p95_index < 0) p95_index = 0;
        p95_us = sorted[p95_index];
    }

    printf("BENCH_SAMPLES_BEGIN\n");
    for (int i = 0; i < runs; ++i) {
        printf("BENCH_SAMPLE,%d,%d,%lld,%" PRIu32 ",%d,%d,%d\n",
               i + 1, samples[i].image, samples[i].us,
               samples[i].cycles, samples[i].raw_person,
               samples[i].raw_no_person, samples[i].ok);
    }
    printf("BENCH_SAMPLES_END\n");

    printf("BENCH_SUMMARY,runs=%d,successful_runs=%d,failures=%d,"
           "mean_us=%lld,median_us=%lld,p95_nearest_rank_us=%lld,"
           "min_us=%lld,max_us=%lld\n",
           runs, successful_runs, failures, mean_us, median,
           p95_us, min_us, max_us);

    free(sorted);
    free(samples);

    return failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}
